augments.name: Tank Engine
augments.wikiDescription: Scoring a champion takedown generates a stack, stacking infinitely. For each stack, increase your maximum health and size by 5%. Lose 65% of stacks on death.
augments.description_zh_TW: 參與擊殺時獲得一層堆層，可增加體型和最大生命。死亡時失去層數。
augments.description_zh_CN: 参与击杀时，获得一个层数，使你的体型增大并提升最大生命值。阵亡时损失层数。
augments.description_ja: キルまたはアシストを獲得すると、自分のサイズと最大体力を増加させるスタックを獲得する。倒されるとスタックを失う。
augments.description_ko: 처치 관여 시 중첩을 얻어 크기가 커지고 최대 체력이 증가합니다. 사망 시 중첩을 잃습니다.

augments.name: Steel Your Heart
augments.wikiDescription: Quest: Obtain Heartsteel and accumulate over 300 bonus health from Colossal Consumption. Reward: Upon completing your Quest, increase the bonus health gained from Heartsteel's Colossal Consumption by 200%.
augments.description_zh_TW: 任務：擁有@StackThreshold@層以上的雄心之鋼。 獎勵：雄心之鋼堆層乘以@StackMultiplication@倍。
augments.description_zh_CN: 任务：持有【心之钢】且层数在@StackThreshold@层或以上。 奖励：将你的【心之钢】层数乘以@StackMultiplication@。
augments.description_ja: クエスト: @StackThreshold@スタック以上の「心の鋼」を所有する。 報酬: 「心の鋼」のスタックが@StackMultiplication@倍になる。
augments.description_ko: 퀘스트: 효과가 @StackThreshold@중첩 이상 적용된 강철심장을 보유해야 합니다. 보상: 강철심장 중첩이 @StackMultiplication@배가 됩니다.

augments.name: Heavy Hitter
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 3.5% of your maximum health.
augments.description_zh_TW: 你的普攻額外造成等同於自身最大生命@HealthPercent*100@%的物理傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的攻击造成相当于你@HealthPercent*100@%最大生命值的额外物理伤害。
augments.description_ja: 通常攻撃が自身の最大体力の@HealthPercent*100@%にあたる追加物理ダメージを与える。
augments.description_ko: 기본 공격 시 최대 체력의 @HealthPercent*100@%에 해당하는 추가 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

augments.name: Upgrade Infinity Edge

names.ja: インフィニティ エッジ アップグレード

augments.name_ja: インフィニティ エッジ アップグレード
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades Infinity Edge, empowering it to gain Sword of the Divine's Excoriate. Additionally, gain 500. Excoriate: Gain a random amount of bonus critical strike damage that scales up to 50% of your critical strike chance, with the value of this amount changing every 0.25 seconds.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得500金錢。 持有無盡之刃時，你的暴擊會根據%i:scaleCrit%暴擊率造成隨機額外%i:scaleCritMult%暴擊傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得500金币。 装备无尽之刃后，可使你的%i:scaleCrit%暴击几率在每次攻击都会提供随机的%i:scaleCritMult%暴击伤害。
augments.description_ja: 500ゴールドを獲得する。 「インフィニティ エッジ」を装備すると%i:scaleCrit%クリティカル率が通常攻撃ごとにランダムに%i:scaleCritMult%クリティカルダメージを与える。
augments.description_ko: 500골드를 얻습니다. 무한의 대검을 보유하고 있으면 치명타 확률%i:scaleCrit%이 기본 공격 시 무작위로 치명타 피해량%i:scaleCritMult%을 부여합니다.

augments.name: Draw Your Sword
augments.wikiDescription: Become melee, modifying your attack range to 200 (+ 100% bonus attack range from augments) units. Additionally, gain 24% bonus attack damage, 20% bonus attack speed, 24% bonus health, 20% bonus movement speed, and 20% life steal. These bonuses are increased by 0% – 100% (based on champion's default attack range).
augments.description_zh_TW: 變為近戰並增加物攻、生命、攻速、吸血以及跑速(成長幅度取決於你犧牲的距離)。
augments.description_zh_CN: 变为近战状态，并且获得攻击力、生命值、攻击速度、生命偷取和移动速度 (每个属性都基于舍弃的攻击距离而进一步提升)。
augments.description_ja: 近接攻撃チャンピオンに変化し、攻撃力、体力、攻撃速度、ライフスティール、移動速度が増加する(減少した射程距離に応じて増加する)。
augments.description_ko: 이제 근접 챔피언으로 간주됩니다. 공격력, 체력, 공격 속도, 생명력 흡수 효과, 이동 속도를 얻습니다. 각 능력치는 잃은 공격 사거리에 따라 추가로 증가합니다.

augments.name: Infinite Recursion
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 60 ability haste, increased by 3 each time you score a champion takedown.
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加@StartingHaste@技能加速，每次參與擊殺則額外增加@HastePerStack@技能加速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@StartingHaste@技能急速，外加每次参与击杀@HastePerStack@技能急速。
augments.description_ja: スキルヘイストが@StartingHaste@増加する。さらに、キルまたはアシストごとに、スキルヘイストが@HastePerStack@増加する。
augments.description_ko: 스킬 가속을 @StartingHaste@+처치 관여당 @HastePerStack@ 얻습니다.

augments.name: Warlock Juicebox
augments.name_ja: 大魔導師のジュースボックス
augments.wikiDescription: Gain the required number of Omnivamp.

augments.name: Dropkick
augments.wikiDescription: Your basic attacks and abilities execute enemy champions below 4% (+ 5.5% per 100 base AD) (+ 1% per 1000 bonus health) of their maximum health, which causes their corpse to be sent flying away in a line. Upon collision with an enemy champion or terrain, the target's corpse explodes to deal 150 – 500 (based on level) (+ 100% bonus armor) (+ 100% bonus magic resistance) magic damage to nearby enemies. Successful executions heal you for 100 – 300 (based on level) (+ 25% bonus health). The execution may also be triggered by the explosion and ignores shields.
augments.description_zh_TW: 普攻和技能會處決低生命的敵方英雄、造成擊退並引發爆炸，同時回復自身生命。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的攻击和技能会处决低生命值的敌方英雄，从而击退并引发一次爆炸，同时治疗你自身。
augments.description_ja: 通常攻撃とスキルが、体力の低い敵チャンピオンにとどめを刺す。また、その敵をノックバックして爆発を起こし、自身を回復する。
augments.description_ko: 기본 공격 및 스킬이 체력이 낮은 적 챔피언을 처형하고, 뒤로 밀어내 폭발시키며 자신의 체력을 회복합니다.

augments.name: Phenomenal Evil
augments.wikiDescription: Gain Veigar's Phenomenal Evil Power. Phenomenal Evil Power: Generate a permanent stack of Phenomenal Evil each time you damage an enemy champion with ability damage. This effect cannot trigger more than once every second globally and once every 3 seconds from the same cast instance. For each stack, gain 1 ability power. If this is not your first augment, start with 40 Phenomenal Evil stacks, granting you 40 ability power. The 40 bonus stacks for selecting this augment as not your first augment are given once the first stack is earned.
augments.description_zh_TW: 使用技能對敵方英雄造成傷害後，可永久增加@APPerProc@魔攻。 若這是你拿的第二件增幅裝置，開始時有@StartingAPIfSecondAugment@魔攻。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在你用技能对敌人造成伤害时永久获得@APPerProc@法术强度。 如果是作为你的第二个强化符文，则自带@StartingAPIfSecondAugment@法术强度。
augments.description_ja: スキルで敵チャンピオンにダメージを与えると、魔力が@APPerProc@恒久的に増加する。 2つ目のオーグメントとして入手した場合は、@StartingAPIfSecondAugment@の魔力で始まる。
augments.description_ko: 스킬로 적 챔피언에게 피해를 입히면 영구적으로 @APPerProc@의 주문력을 얻습니다. 두 번째 증강일 경우 @StartingAPIfSecondAugment@의 주문력으로 시작합니다.

augments.name: Pressure Cooker
augments.wikiDescription: Surrounds you in flames, causing you to apply a Burn every second to enemy champions within 300 units for 3 seconds that deals magic damage equal to「 0.5% of your maximum health per second. 」「 1.5% of your maximum health over the duration. 」This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application. Additionally, you are assigned with quests that require you to deal a certain amount of damage with the Burn effect against enemy champions. There are three quest tiers, and each completed tier grants you a reward that improves Pressure Cooker's effect.
augments.description_zh_TW: 每秒對鄰近敵方英雄附加一層燃燒，傷害隨你的最大生命成長。 任務：對敵方英雄造成燃燒傷害。 獎勵：任務每升一級，提升體型和傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 每一秒，对附近的敌方英雄们施加一层可叠加的灼烧，这个效果受益于你的最大生命值。 任务：对敌方英雄造成灼烧伤害 奖励：提升【高压锅】的规模和伤害，基于任务等级。
augments.description_ja: 1秒ごとに、周囲の敵チャンピオンに炎上のスタックを付与し、自身の最大体力に応じたダメージを与える。 クエスト: 敵チャンピオンに炎上ダメージを与える。 報酬: クエストレベルに応じてサイズとダメージが増加する。
augments.description_ko: 매초 최대 체력에 비례해 주변 적 챔피언에게 중첩되는 화상 효과를 적용합니다. 퀘스트: 적 챔피언에게 화상 피해를 입혀야 합니다. 보상: 퀘스트 레벨당 크기와 피해량이 증가합니다.

augments.name: Icathia's Fall
augments.wikiDescription: Gain Bami's Cinder. You can now purchase Hollow Radiance and Sunfire Aegis in spite of the item limit imposed by Immolate. Quest: Obtain Hollow Radiance and Sunfire Aegis. Reward: Upon completing your Quest, convert the items you obtained for the quest into Void Immolation. While you have Void Immolation, you will be imposed with Immolate's item limit. When gaining Bami's Cinder, you will lose an Ruby Crystal or a Glowing Mote in your inventory as it will get upgraded with no gold returned back to you.(bug)
augments.description_zh_TW: 立即獲得一個巴米灰燼。 任務：持有日炎聖盾和虛偽光彩。 獎勵：這些道具能合成虛空獻祭。
augments.description_zh_CN: 即刻：获得1个【斑比的熔渣】。 任务：持有日炎圣盾和璀璨回响。 奖励：将这些装备合成为虚空献祭。
augments.description_ja: 即時: 「バミ シンダー」を1個獲得する。 クエスト: 「サンファイア イージス」と「ホロウ レディアンス」を所持する。 報酬: これらのアイテムが組み合わさって「ヴォイドの猛火」になる。
augments.description_ko: 즉시: 바미의 불씨를 획득합니다. 퀘스트: 태양불꽃 방패와 공허한 광휘를 보유해야 합니다. 보상: 두 아이템이 공허의 불길로 합쳐집니다.

augments.name: Goliath
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 35% bonus health, 15% adaptive force, and 50% increased size.
augments.description_zh_TW: 體型變大，增加@HealthAmp*100@%生命及@AFAmp*100@%適性之力。
augments.description_zh_CN: 体型变大，获得@HealthAmp*100@%生命值和@AFAmp*100@%适应之力。
augments.description_ja: サイズが大きくなり、体力が@HealthAmp*100@%、アダプティブフォースが@AFAmp*100@%増加する。
augments.description_ko: 크기가 커져 체력이 @HealthAmp*100@% 증가하고 적응형 능력치가 @AFAmp*100@% 증가합니다.

augments.name: Combusting Interest
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 1 – 3 (based on level) (+ 0.75% of damage dealt) gold for each tick of damage dealt to enemy champions with damage over time effects.
augments.description_zh_TW: 對英雄造成的燃燒和持續傷害效果會產生金錢。
augments.description_zh_CN: 英雄身上的灼烧和持续伤害会生成金币。
augments.description_ja: チャンピオンに「炎上」効果と継続ダメージを与えると ゴールドを獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 챔피언에게 적용한 화상 및 지속 피해 효과가 골드를 생성합니다.

augments.name: Magic Missile
augments.wikiDescription: Dealing damage to an enemy champion with an ability fires 3 missiles at them that each deal true damage equal to 0.33% of the target's maximum health, increased to up to 1% based on distance travelled (maximum damage reached at 1000 units). This effect can only trigger once every 6 seconds from the same cast.
augments.description_zh_TW: 造成技能傷害會對目標發射@NumberOfMissiles@枚飛彈，每一枚飛彈會根據飛行距離造成百分比最大生命的真實傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 造成技能伤害会对其发射@NumberOfMissiles@个飞弹，每个造成基于飞行距离的百分比最大生命值的真实伤害。
augments.description_ja: スキルでダメージを与えると、@NumberOfMissiles@発のミサイルが発射され、それぞれが飛行距離に応じて最大体力の一定割合の確定ダメージを与える。
augments.description_ko: 스킬 피해를 입히면 투사체 @NumberOfMissiles@개를 발사해 이동한 거리에 따라 각각 최대 체력 비례 고정 피해를 입힙니다.

augments.name: Eureka
augments.wikiDescription: Gain ability haste equal to 30% AP.
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加相當於@APToHasteConversion*100@%魔攻的技能加速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得相当于@APToHasteConversion*100@%法术强度的技能急速。
augments.description_ja: 魔力の@APToHasteConversion*100@%にあたるスキルヘイストを獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 주문력의 @APToHasteConversion*100@%에 해당하는 스킬 가속을 얻습니다.

augments.name: Dual Wield
augments.wikiDescription: Your basic attacks launch a bolt at the target that fires after a 0.225-second delay on-attack, deals 40% of the triggering attack's pre-mitigation damage, and applies on-hit effects at 40% effectiveness. Additionally, increase your total attack speed by 10%.
augments.description_zh_TW: 普攻會射出一道箭矢，施加{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}但威力減弱。增加@AttackSpeed*100@%總攻速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在攻击时，发射一个箭矢，它施加效能削减的{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}。获得@AttackSpeed*100@%总攻击速度。
augments.description_ja: 通常攻撃で矢を放ち、効果が低下した{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}を適用する。合計攻撃速度が@AttackSpeed*100@%増加する。
augments.description_ko: 기본 공격 시 감소한 {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} 효과를 적용하는 투사체를 발사합니다. 총 공격 속도가 @AttackSpeed*100@% 증가합니다.

augments.name: Infernal Conduit
augments.wikiDescription: Your ability hits against champions apply a Burn for 3 seconds that deals「 2 – 20 (based on level) (+ 4.6% bonus AD) (+ 2% AP) bonus magic damage per second 」「 6 – 60 (based on level) (+ 14% bonus AD) (+ 6% AP) bonus magic damage over the duration 」(1 second cooldown per cast instance). This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application. Additionally, all of your Burn effects reduce the cooldowns of all your basic abilities by 0.08 seconds for each tick of damage they deal to a target. Damage over time effects from all sources except items(unexpected) count as Burn sources for triggering the cooldown reduction. Eligible Augments for Burn: Buff Buddies, Firebrand, Grandma's Chili Oil, Holy Fire, Infernal Conduit, Slow Cooker
augments.description_zh_TW: 技能附加可累加的燃燒，此效果會持續造成傷害。 你施加的燃燒效果可縮短基礎技能冷卻時間。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的技能会施加一层可叠加的灼烧，持续造成魔法伤害。 你的灼烧效果会降低你各基础技能的冷却时间。
augments.description_ja: スキルが炎上のスタックを適用し、継続ダメージを与える。 敵に炎上の効果を与えると、自身の通常スキルのクールダウンが短縮される。
augments.description_ko: 스킬 사용 시 중첩되는 화상 효과를 적용해 지속적으로 피해를 입힙니다. 화상 효과가 기본 스킬의 재사용 대기시간을 감소시킵니다.

augments.name: Upgrade Immolate

names.ja: 猛火 アップグレード

augments.name_ja: 猛火 アップグレード
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades Bami's Cinder, Hollow Radiance, Sunfire Aegis, and Void Immolation, empowering Immolate to additionally grant you 12 per tick for each enemy champion afflicted by its effect. Additionally, gain 250. Clones do not count as valid targets for the effect.
augments.description_zh_TW: 每有一名受獻祭影響的目標，虛偽光彩和日炎聖盾賦予@GoldPerTick@金錢。獲得250金錢。
augments.description_zh_CN: 【璀璨回响】和【日炎圣盾】每当有目标受到【献祭】效果影响时，提供@GoldPerTick@ 金币 。获得250金币。
augments.description_ja: 「ホロウ レディアンス」と「サンファイア イージス」が「猛火」の影響を受けた対象1体ごとに@GoldPerTick@ゴールドを付与する。250ゴールドを獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 공허한 광휘 및 태양불꽃 방패가 불사르기 효과가 적용된 대상 수에 비례하여 @GoldPerTick@골드를 제공합니다. 250골드를 획득합니다.

augments.name: Goredrink
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 15% omnivamp.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得@Omnivamp*100@%全能吸血效果。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@Omnivamp*100@%全能吸血。
augments.description_ja: オムニヴァンプが@Omnivamp*100@%増加する。
augments.description_ko: 모든 피해 흡혈 @Omnivamp*100@%를 얻습니다.

augments.name: Deft
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 60% bonus attack speed.
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加%i:scaleAS% @AttackSpeed*100@%攻速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得%i:scaleAS% @AttackSpeed*100@%攻击速度。
augments.description_ja: %i:scaleAS%攻撃速度が@AttackSpeed*100@%増加する。
augments.description_ko: %i:scaleAS% @AttackSpeed*100@%의 공격 속도를 얻습니다.

augments.name: Giant Slayer

names.ja: ジャイアント スレイヤー

augments.name_ja: ジャイアント スレイヤー
augments.wikiDescription: Become tiny, reducing your size by 75% and granting you 20% bonus movement speed. Additionally, deal 10% / 15% / 25% / 30% (based on target's size) bonus damage against enemy champions with greater size than you.
augments.description_zh_TW: 體型變小，獲得跑速，並根據目標英雄與自身體型差距造成額外傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 体型变小，获得移动速度，并基于敌方英雄体型大于你的程度获得额外伤害。
augments.description_ja: 小さくなって移動速度が増加する。また、対象のチャンピオンが自身よりどれだけ大きいかに応じて、追加ダメージを獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 크기가 작아져 이동 속도가 증가하며 상대가 자신보다 큰 정도에 비례해 챔피언에게 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

augments.name: Blunt Force
augments.wikiDescription: Increases attack damage by 20%.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得%i:scaleAD% @ADAmp*100@%物攻。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得%i:scaleAD%@ADAmp*100@%攻击力。
augments.description_ja: %i:scaleAD%攻撃力が@ADAmp*100@%増加する。
augments.description_ko: %i:scaleAD% 공격력이 @ADAmp*100@% 증가합니다.

augments.name: Transmute: Prismatic
augments.wikiDescription: Gain one random Prismatic-tier augment.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得一件隨機%i:Augment%稜鏡增幅裝置。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得1个随机%i:Augment%棱彩阶强化符文。
augments.description_ja: ランダムな%i:Augment%プリズムオーグメントを1個獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 무작위 %i:Augment% 프리즘 증강을 획득합니다.

augments.name: Ethereal Weapon
augments.wikiDescription: Your abilities apply on-hit effects (1 second cooldown per target).
augments.description_zh_TW: 技能會施加{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}。對每個目標有1秒冷卻時間。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的技能可施加{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}。每个目标有1秒冷却时间。
augments.description_ja: スキルが{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}を付与する。対象ごとにクールダウン1秒。
augments.description_ko: 스킬이 {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} 효과를 적용합니다. 대상마다 1초의 재사용 대기시간이 적용됩니다.

augments.name: Celestial Body
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 1500 bonus health, but reduce your damage output by 10%.
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加@Health@生命，但造成的傷害降低@DamageReduction*100@%。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@Health@生命值，但你造成的伤害降低@DamageReduction*100@%。
augments.description_ja: 体力が@Health@増加する代わりに、与えるダメージが@DamageReduction*100@%低下する。
augments.description_ko: @Health@의 체력을 얻지만, 피해량이 @DamageReduction*100@% 감소합니다.

augments.name: Scopier Weapons
augments.wikiDescription: Gain ( 200 / 100) bonus attack range.
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加@RangeIncrease@攻擊距離。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@RangeIncrease@攻击距离。
augments.description_ja: 射程距離が@RangeIncrease@増加する。
augments.description_ko: 공격 사거리가 @RangeIncrease@ 증가합니다.

augments.name: Stackosaurus Rex

names.ja: スタックサウルス・レックス

augments.name_ja: スタックサウルス・レックス
augments.wikiDescription: Increase the number of permanent stacks you gain from abilities by 100%.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得技能的永久堆層時，額外獲得@StackModifier*100@%！
augments.description_zh_CN: 在你获得一个技能的永久层数时，多获得@StackModifier*100@%！
augments.description_ja: 恒久的なスキルのスタックを獲得する際に、獲得量が@StackModifier*100@%増加する！
augments.description_ko: 스킬 중첩을 영구적으로 획득할 때마다 @StackModifier*100@% 더 획득합니다!

augments.name: Twin Fire
augments.wikiDescription: Damaging abilities against enemy champions launch 1 (+ 1 per 33.33% critical strike chance) missiles at the target that each deal 10 – 30 (based on level) (+ 7% bonus AD) (+ 7% AP) magic damage (5 second cooldown). Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.
augments.description_zh_TW: 造成技能傷害時，發射1+@AdditionalMis@枚飛彈，每一枚造成@Damage@魔法傷害。 增加%i:scaleCrit% @CrtiChance*100@%暴擊率。
augments.description_zh_CN: 造成技能伤害时，发射1+@AdditionalMis@个飞弹，每个造成@Damage@魔法伤害。 此外，获得%i:scaleCrit%@CrtiChance*100@%暴击几率。
augments.description_ja: スキルダメージ時、1 + @AdditionalMis@個のミサイルを発射し、それぞれ@Damage@の魔法ダメージを与える。 %i:scaleCrit%クリティカル率が@CrtiChance*100@%増加する。
augments.description_ko: 스킬 피해를 입히면 투사체 1+@AdditionalMis@개를 발사해 각각 @Damage@의 마법 피해를 입힙니다. %i:scaleCrit% 치명타 확률이 @CrtiChance*100@% 증가합니다.

augments.name: Spirit Bomb
augments.wikiDescription: Your healing and shielding on yourself or allies builds up a Spirit Bomb on top of you. Once you have healed and shielded a combined total of 200 – 2000 (based on level), you toss the Spirit Bomb onto the most wounded allied champion over 1.1 seconds. Upon impact, the Spirit Bomb explodes in a 475 radius to heal allied champions within the area for 5% – 15% (based on level) (+ 3% per 100 AP) of their missing health and grants them a shield for 2 seconds that absorbs damage equal to 10% – 25% (based on level) (+ 2% per 100 AP) of their current health. Healing and shielding from this effect do not count toward the Spirit Bomb's trigger condition. The toss range for the Spirit Bomb is global; it will target the lowest-health ally on the map.
augments.description_zh_TW: 對友方英雄進行治療和護盾會累積靈魂炸彈。滿層時，將該炸彈丟到生命最低的友軍身上，為其及附近友軍提供治療並護盾。
augments.description_zh_CN: 为友方英雄提供治疗和护盾时会为你积攒一颗【灵魄炸弹】。在满层时，投掷该炸弹至生命值最低的那个友军，从而对其和附近友军们提供治疗和护盾。
augments.description_ja: 味方チャンピオンに体力回復効果やシールドを付与すると、スピリットボムがチャージされる。最大スタック時、体力が最も低い味方にボムを投げて、その味方と周囲の味方の体力を回復してシールドを付与する。
augments.description_ko: 아군 챔피언의 체력을 회복시키거나 보호막을 씌우면 영혼 폭탄이 중첩됩니다. 최대 중첩 시 체력이 가장 낮은 아군에게 폭탄을 던져, 해당 아군 및 주변 아군의 체력을 회복시키고 보호막을 부여합니다.

augments.name: Ocean Soul
augments.wikiDescription: Grants the Ocean Dragon Soul, which has a modified base heal value of 100, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得海洋之魂，對敵軍造成傷害後可增加大量生命及魔力回復。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得【海洋龙魂】，在对敌方英雄造成伤害后提供高额的生命和法力回复。
augments.description_ja: 「オーシャンソウル」を獲得し、敵にダメージを与えると体力およびマナの自動回復量が増加する。
augments.description_ko: 적에게 피해를 입힌 후 높은 체력 및 마나 재생 효과를 얻는 바다의 영혼을 획득합니다.

augments.name: ADAPt
augments.wikiDescription: Convert all of your bonus attack damage into ability power at a rate of 1 ability power per 0.6 bonus attack damage. Additionally, increase your ability power by 15%.
augments.description_zh_TW: 將額外物攻轉換為魔攻。增加@APAmp*100@%魔攻。
augments.description_zh_CN: 将额外攻击力转化为法术强度。获得@APAmp*100@%法术强度。
augments.description_ja: 増加攻撃力を魔力に変換する。魔力が@APAmp*100@%増加する。
augments.description_ko: 추가 공격력을 주문력으로 전환합니다. 주문력이 @APAmp*100@% 증가합니다.

augments.name: Back To Basics
augments.wikiDescription: Your champion abilities deal 35% increased damage and you gain 70 ability haste and 35% increased healing and shielding from all sources, but your ultimate ability is permanently sealed.
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加技能傷害、治療、護盾，並獲得技能加速，但無法使用大絕。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得提升过的技能伤害、治疗效果、护盾和技能急速，但你不能使用你的终极技能。
augments.description_ja: スキルダメージ、体力回復効果、シールド効果、スキルヘイストが増加する代わりに、アルティメットスキルを使用できなくなる。
augments.description_ko: 스킬 피해량, 체력 회복량, 보호막 흡수량 및 스킬 가속이 증가하지만 궁극기를 사용할 수 없습니다.

augments.name: Windspeaker's Blessing
augments.wikiDescription: Your or allies' heals and shields on yourself, or your heals and shields on allies, grant the target 30 – 60 (based on level) bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for 3 seconds.
augments.description_zh_TW: 治療與護盾效果同時會增加目標的物理防禦與魔法防禦3秒。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的治疗效果和护盾效果还会提升目标的护甲和魔法抗性，这些加成持续3秒。
augments.description_ja: 自身の体力回復効果およびシールド効果が、3秒間対象の物理防御と魔法防御を増加させる。
augments.description_ko: 회복 및 보호막 효과를 부여하면 3초 동안 대상의 방어력 및 마법 저항력이 증가합니다.

augments.name: High Roller
augments.wikiDescription: Nearby enemies that die have a 1.5% chance to drop a Stat Anvil at the location of their death. You can pick up dropped anvils by moving over them. The obtained Stat Anvils will be consumed once the shop is enabled again (after your death).
augments.description_zh_TW: 鄰近敵軍在死亡時有機會掉落能力值鐵砧。
augments.description_zh_CN: 附近敌人在阵亡时有几率掉落【属性锻造器】。
augments.description_ja: 周囲の敵が倒された際に、一定の確率で「ステータスの金床」をドロップする。
augments.description_ko: 주변 적이 죽을 때 일정 확률로 능력치 모루를 떨어뜨립니다.

augments.name: Wee Woo Wee Woo
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 0% – 50% (based on target ally's missing health) bonus movement speed while facing toward nearby allied champions, lingering for 2 seconds after no longer facing them. Your heals and shields are also increased by 0% – 50% (based on target's missing health).
augments.description_zh_TW: 當你朝生命較低的友軍移動時，會獲得跑速。目標生命越低，你的治療和護盾效果越強。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在朝着低生命值的友军移动时，获得移动速度。你的治疗和护盾获得提升，基于你目标的低生命值程度。
augments.description_ja: 体力が低下している味方に向かって移動する際、移動速度が増加する。対象の体力が低いほど、回復効果とシールド効果が大きくなる。
augments.description_ko: 체력이 낮은 아군을 향해 이동할 때 이동 속도가 증가합니다. 대상의 체력이 낮을수록 체력 회복량 및 보호막 흡수량이 증가합니다.

augments.name: Mystic Punch
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks on-hit reduce the remaining cooldowns of your abilities by 1.25 seconds.
augments.description_zh_TW: {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}會縮短技能冷卻時間@CooldownRefund@秒%i:scaleCooldown%。
augments.description_zh_CN: {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}使你的各个技能的冷却时间缩减@CooldownRefund@秒%i:scaleCooldown%。
augments.description_ja: {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}がスキルのクールダウンを@CooldownRefund@秒短縮する%i:scaleCooldown%。
augments.description_ko: {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} 스킬의 재사용 대기시간이 @CooldownRefund@초 %i:scaleCooldown% 감소합니다.

augments.name: Pursuit of Haste
augments.wikiDescription: Assigns quests that require you to hit enemy champions with a specific ability a number of times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance). There are two quest tiers, and each completed tier rewards you with ability haste on the ability.

augments.name: Upgrade Collector

names.ja: コレクター アップグレード

augments.name_ja: コレクター アップグレード
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades The Collector, empowering Death to have its execution threshold increased by 0.5% each time you kill an enemy champion, capped at a threshold of 12.5% of the target's maximum health, and Taxes to generate a further 25 (total 50) from kills. Additionally, gain 250.
augments.description_zh_TW: 以蒐集者的被動效果處決敵軍時，會提升處決門檻並獲得額外金錢。 獲得250金錢。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在每次使用【收集者】的被动处决敌人时，会提升处决阈值，并且提供额外金币。 获得250金币。
augments.description_ja: 「コレクター」の自動効果で対象を倒すと、とどめを刺す体力境界値が増加し、追加でゴールドを付与する。 250ゴールドを獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 징수의 총 기본 지속 효과로 적을 처형하면 처형 기준치가 높아지며 추가 골드를 얻습니다. 250골드를 획득합니다.

augments.name: Shadow Runner
augments.wikiDescription: After dashing, blinking, or exiting stealth, gain 300 bonus movement speed for 2 seconds.
augments.description_zh_TW: 使用衝刺、閃現或傳送技能或脫離潛行後，增加跑速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在使用一个冲刺、闪烁或传送类技能或离开潜行状态之后，获得移动速度。
augments.description_ja: ダッシュ、ブリンク、またはテレポートを行うスキルを使用した後、もしくはステルス状態解除後に、移動速度が増加する。
augments.description_ko: 돌진, 점멸, 순간이동 스킬을 사용하거나 은신 상태에서 벗어난 후 이동 속도가 증가합니다.

augments.name: Ice Cold
augments.wikiDescription: Your slowing effects reduce the movement speed of targets by an additional 75.
augments.description_zh_TW: 造成的緩速效果額外降低@ExtraSlowAmount@跑速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的减速效果可使移动速度降低额外的@ExtraSlowAmount@。
augments.description_ja: 敵へのスロウ効果で、移動速度が追加で@ExtraSlowAmount@低下する。
augments.description_ko: 둔화 효과가 이동 속도를 추가로 @ExtraSlowAmount@ 감소시킵니다.

augments.name: Sonata
augments.wikiDescription: Alternate between automatically casting a modified version of Sona's Aria of Perseverance and modified Song of Celerity, with the former being cast first (10 second cooldown). Aria of Perseverance: Heal yourself for 60 (+ 60% AP) and send out a tone to the most wounded allied champion within 1000 units that heals them for the same amount. Additionally, generate an aura that grants you and tagged allied champions a 80 (+ 40% AP) shield for 1.5 seconds. Song of Celerity: Gain 30% bonus movement speed for 7 seconds. If you take damage during this time, the duration ends prematurely once or if 3 seconds have elapsed. Additionally, generate an aura that grants tagged allied champions 20% bonus movement speed for 3 seconds.
augments.description_zh_TW: 每隔@Cooldown@秒自動輪替施放堅毅詠嘆調和迅捷奏鳴曲。 堅毅詠嘆調使鄰近友軍回復生命，並暫時獲得護盾靈氣。 迅捷奏鳴曲暫時賦予可增加跑速的靈氣。
augments.description_zh_CN: 每@Cooldown@秒，以一个不断交替的旋律来自动施放坚毅咏叹调和迅捷奏鸣曲。 坚毅咏叹调治疗附近友军并提供一个临时的护盾光环。 迅捷奏鸣曲提供一个临时光环来提供额外移动速度。
augments.description_ja: @Cooldown@秒ごとに、忍耐のアリアとセレリティを交互に自動発動する旋律を奏でる。 忍耐のアリアは周囲の味方を回復し、一時的にシールドオーラを付与する。 セレリティが一時的にオーラを付与し、移動速度が増加する。
augments.description_ko: @Cooldown@초마다 인내의 아리아와 기민함의 노래를 번갈아 자동 사용합니다. 인내의 아리아는 주변 아군의 체력을 회복시키고 일시적으로 보호막 오라를 부여합니다. 기민함의 노래는 추가 이동 속도를 부여하는 오라를 잠시 동안 생성합니다.

augments.name: Slap Around
augments.wikiDescription: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants you 6 bonus Attack Damage or 10 Ability Power (Adaptive), stacking infinitely (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Lose 50% of stacks on death. If the bonus attack damage and the ability power of the unit are equal, the stat granted is always bonus AD.(unexpected)
augments.description_zh_TW: 硬控場或禁錮敵軍時，獲得@AdaptiveForce@適性之力。死亡時失去@PercentOfStacksLost*100@%。
augments.description_zh_CN: 每当你定身或缚地一个敌人时，获得@AdaptiveForce@适应之力。阵亡时损失@PercentOfStacksLost*100@%。
augments.description_ja: 敵に移動不能効果か釘付け効果を与えると、アダプティブフォースが@AdaptiveForce@増加する。倒されると@PercentOfStacksLost*100@%を失う。
augments.description_ko: 적을 이동 불가 상태로 만들거나 이동 스킬을 사용할 수 없게 하면 @AdaptiveForce@의 적응형 능력치를 얻습니다. 사망 시 @PercentOfStacksLost*100@%를 잃습니다.

augments.name: Wooglet's Witchcap

names.ja: ウーグレット ウィッチキャップ

augments.name_ja: ウーグレット ウィッチキャップ
augments.wikiDescription: Gain a Needlessly Large Rod. Quest: Obtain Rabadon's Deathcap and Zhonya's Hourglass. Reward: Upon completing your Quest, convert the items you obtained for the quest into Wooglet's Witchcap. Wooglet's Witchcap Stasis cooldown changed to 60 seconds.
augments.description_zh_TW: 立刻獲得巨型魔棒。 條件：擁有死亡之帽和中婭沙漏。 獎勵：獲得烏莉特的法帽。
augments.description_zh_CN: 立刻：获得无用大棒。 需求：持有灭世者的死亡之帽和中娅沙漏。 奖励:获得沃格勒特的巫师帽。
augments.description_ja: 即時: 「ムダニ デカイ ロッド」を獲得する。 条件: 「ラバドン デスキャップ」と「ゾーニャの砂時計」を所有する。 報酬: 「ウーグレット ウィッチキャップ」を獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 즉시: 쓸데없이 큰 지팡이를 획득합니다. 조건: 라바돈의 죽음모자와 존야의 모래시계를 보유해야 합니다. 보상: 우글렛의 마녀 모자를 획득합니다.

augments.name: Witchful Thinking
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 20 – 80 (based on level) ability power.
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加%i:scaleAP% @AP@魔攻。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得%i:scaleAP%@AP@法术强度。
augments.description_ja: %i:scaleAP%魔力が@AP@増加する。
augments.description_ko: %i:scaleAP% 주문력이 @AP@ 증가합니다.

augments.name: Skilled Sniper
augments.wikiDescription: Hitting an enemy champion with a basic ability while located at least 600 units away from them at the time of the hit reduces its current cooldown by 80% of its total cooldown, modified to 65% for damage over time abilities.
augments.description_zh_TW: 以非大絕技能狙擊敵軍時，可縮短冷卻時間@ReducedCooldownPercent*100@%(持續性技能為@PeriodicReductionAmount*100@%)。
augments.description_zh_CN: 用一个非终极技能狙击一个敌人时，返还该技能@ReducedCooldownPercent*100@%冷却时间(周期性技能返还@PeriodicReductionAmount*100@%)。
augments.description_ja: アルティメット以外のスキルで敵をスナイプすると、そのスキルのクールダウンが@ReducedCooldownPercent*100@%短縮される(継続的に効果を与えるスキルは@PeriodicReductionAmount*100@%)。
augments.description_ko: 기본 스킬로 적을 저격하면 해당 스킬의 재사용 대기시간이 @ReducedCooldownPercent*100@% 반환됩니다. (지속 스킬의 경우 @PeriodicReductionAmount*100@%)

augments.name: Forged By The Master
augments.name_ja: マスターに鍛えられて
augments.wikiDescription: Increase your Item and Augment damage by the required number of.

augments.name: Fan The Hammer
augments.wikiDescription: Your next basic attack against an enemy champion in each cardinal direction within 750 range additionally on-attack fires 5 missiles at the target that each deal 8 – 51 (based on level) (+ 14% bonus AD) physical damage, for a total of 40 – 255 (based on level) (+ 70% bonus AD) physical damage (5 second cooldown per direction). Missiles' damage is increased by 0% – 50% (based on distance travelled). Each missile can critically strike for (200% + 30%) damage and applies on-hit effects at 20% effectiveness.
augments.description_zh_TW: 對敵方英雄普攻時，發射@AdditionalBolts@枚飛彈，傷害量隨飛行距離增加。每個方向的冷卻時間各不相同。
augments.description_zh_CN: 对敌方英雄的攻击会发射@AdditionalBolts@个额外飞弹，造成随距离提升的额外伤害。每个方向的冷却时间独立计算。
augments.description_ja: 敵チャンピオンに対する通常攻撃で@AdditionalBolts@発のミサイルが発射され、距離に応じてより多くのダメージを与える。各方向に個別のクールダウンがある。
augments.description_ko: 적 챔피언 공격 시 이동한 거리에 비례해 피해량이 증가하는 투사체 @AdditionalBolts@개를 발사합니다. 방향마다 재사용 대기시간이 따로 적용됩니다.

augments.name: Escape Plan
augments.wikiDescription: Upon dropping below 35% of your maximum health, gain a shield for 65% of your maximum health, 150% bonus movement speed, and reduced size (75 second cooldown). These effects all decay over 5.5 seconds.
augments.description_zh_TW: 達到@HealthThreshold*100@%生命時，獲得大量逐漸衰減的護盾、逐漸衰減的跑速，以及逐漸恢復的縮小效果。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在降至@HealthThreshold*100@%生命值时，获得巨量持续衰减的护盾、持续衰减的移动速度和持续衰减的缩小效果。
augments.description_ja: 体力が@HealthThreshold*100@%に達したときに、大量の徐々に減少するシールドを獲得し、移動速度が増加し、縮小効果を獲得する。これらは時間とともに徐々に減少する。
augments.description_ko: 체력이 @HealthThreshold*100@%가 되면 막대한 보호막, 이동 속도, 축소 효과를 얻습니다. 이러한 효과는 시간이 지나면 점차 사라집니다.

augments.name: Mind to Matter
augments.wikiDescription: Grants bonus health equal to 50% maximum mana. Maximum bonus health granted by this effect is capped at 99,999 bonus health.
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加最大生命，增加量為魔力的一半。
augments.description_zh_CN: 使你的最大生命值提升，数额相当于你一半的法力值。
augments.description_ja: マナの半分にあたる最大体力を獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 최대 체력이 마나의 절반만큼 증가합니다.

augments.name: Tap Dancer
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks on-hit against enemy champions and minions grant 10 bonus movement speed, lasting for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent triggers, and stacking infinitely. Additionally, gain bonus attack speed equal to 10% total movement speed.
augments.description_zh_TW: 普攻可增加跑速。根據跑速獲得攻速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的攻击会为你提供移动速度。基于你的移动速度获得攻击速度。
augments.description_ja: 通常攻撃で移動速度が増加する。移動速度に応じて攻撃速度が増加する。
augments.description_ko: 기본 공격 시 이동 속도가 증가합니다. 이동 속도에 비례하여 공격 속도가 증가합니다.

augments.name: Shrink Engine
augments.wikiDescription: Scoring a champion takedown generates a stack, stacking infinitely. For each stack, gain 8 ability haste and 1% bonus movement speed, and reduce your size by 4%. Lose 65% of stacks on death. Size reduction is capped at 80% (20 stacks).
augments.description_zh_TW: 參與擊殺會使體型變小，並賦予技能加速及跑速。 死亡時失去@PercentOfStacksLost*100@%堆層。
augments.description_zh_CN: 参与击杀后会让你变小并且获得技能急速和移动速度。 阵亡时损失@PercentOfStacksLost*100@%层数。
augments.description_ja: キルまたはアシストで自身が小さくなり、スキルヘイストと移動速度が増加する。 倒されるとスタックの@PercentOfStacksLost*100@%を失う。
augments.description_ko: 처치 관여 시 크기가 작아지고 스킬 가속 및 이동 속도를 얻습니다. 사망 시 중첩을 @PercentOfStacksLost*100@% 잃습니다.

augments.name: Tooth Fairy
augments.wikiDescription: When you deal damage to an enemy champion equal to or more than 25% of their maximum health within 2.5 seconds, they drop a Tooth on the ground (4 second cooldown per target). You can pick up this Tooth by moving over it, granting you a Dental Records stack. For each stack, you gain 3 lethality and flat magic penetration.
augments.description_zh_TW: 暴擊敵軍會掉落牙齒。撿起牙齒會永久獲得物理致命和魔法穿透。
augments.description_zh_CN: 爆裂敌人会掉落牙齿。拾取牙齿会提供给你永久的穿甲和法术穿透。
augments.description_ja: 敵にバーストダメージを与えると歯がドロップする。歯を拾うと、恒久的に脅威と魔法防御貫通を獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 적에게 폭발적 피해를 입히면 이빨을 떨어뜨립니다. 이빨을 주우면 영구적으로 물리 관통력과 마법 관통력을 얻습니다.

augments.name: Growth Spurt
augments.wikiDescription: Replace a summoner spell with Growth Spurt. Growth Spurt: Enlarge yourself, causing you to knock up enemies within 400 units for 1 second. For the next 7 seconds, you gain 300 (+ 20% maximum health) bonus health and 50% increased size.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得召喚師技能「急遽成長」。 「急遽成長」會使你體型瞬間變大，擊飛鄰近敵軍並賦予你最大生命。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得生机迸发作为一个召唤师技能。 生机迸发会猛然提升你的体型，击飞附近的敌人们并提供最大生命值。
augments.description_ja: サモナースペルの成長期を獲得する。 「成長期」は自身のサイズを急増させ、周囲の敵をノックアップし、最大体力を増加させる。
augments.description_ko: 급속 성장 소환사 주문을 얻습니다. 급속 성장으로 급격히 크기가 커져 주변 적을 공중으로 띄워 올리고, 최대 체력을 얻습니다.

augments.name: escAPADe
augments.wikiDescription: Convert all of your ability power into bonus attack damage at a rate of 1 bonus attack damage per 1.66 ability power. Additionally, increase your total attack damage by 15%. Does not convert the Ability Power obtained from Riftmaker's Void Infusion, nor from Archangel's Staff or Seraph's Embrace's Awe.(bug)
augments.description_zh_TW: 將魔攻轉換為額外物攻。增加@ADAmp*100@%物攻。
augments.description_zh_CN: 将法术强度转化为额外攻击力。获得@ADAmp*100@%攻击力。
augments.description_ja: 魔力を増加攻撃力に変換する。攻撃力が@ADAmp*100@%増加する。
augments.description_ko: 주문력을 추가 공격력으로 전환합니다. 공격력이 @ADAmp*100@% 증가합니다.

augments.name: Mad Scientist
augments.wikiDescription: Upon acquiring this augment and each time you respawn, gain either 30% adaptive force, 20% bonus health, and 40% increased size or 70 ability haste, 40% bonus movement speed, and 40% reduced size.
augments.description_zh_TW: 每次復活時，體型變大(增加適性之力及生命)或變小(增加技能加速及跑速)。
augments.description_zh_CN: 每次重生时，你的体型要么变大(获得适应之力和生命值)，要么变小(获得技能急速和移动速度)。
augments.description_ja: 復活するたびに、自身が巨大化(アダプティブフォースと体力が増加)または小型化(スキルヘイストと移動速度が増加)する。
augments.description_ko: 부활할 때마다 크기가 커져 적응형 능력치와 체력을 얻거나, 크기가 작아져 스킬 가속과 이동 속도를 얻습니다.

augments.name: Light 'Em Up!
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks generate a stack, up to 4. The fourth stack consumes them all to quickly launch 4 missiles at the target that each deal 11 – 80 (based on level) (+ 35% bonus AD) (+ 19% AP) bonus magic damage on-hit, for a total of 44 – 320 (based on level) (+ 140% bonus AD) (+ 76% AP).
augments.description_zh_TW: 每第4次普攻發射4枚飛彈，造成魔法傷害。{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}
augments.description_zh_CN: 每第4次攻击发射4个飞弹以造成魔法伤害{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}。
augments.description_ja: 通常攻撃4回ごとに、ミサイルを4発発射し、魔法ダメージ{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}を与える。
augments.description_ko: 4번째 기본 공격마다 투사체 4개를 발사해 {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

augments.name: Archmage
augments.wikiDescription: Whenever you cast an ability, refund the cooldown of another, randomly selected ability by 30% of the casted ability's cooldown.
augments.description_zh_TW: 施放技能時，會返還另一個隨機技能的費用，數值為原始技能冷卻時間的@RefundPercent*100@%。
augments.description_zh_CN: 施放一个技能会返还另一个随机技能的花费，数额相当于@RefundPercent*100@%原技能冷却时间。
augments.description_ja: スキルを使用すると、ランダムな他のスキルのコストが、最初のスキルのクールダウンの@RefundPercent*100@%解消する。
augments.description_ko: 스킬을 사용하면 사용한 스킬 재사용 대기시간의 @RefundPercent*100@%만큼 다른 무작위 스킬의 재사용 대기시간을 반환합니다.

augments.name: Lil' Extra Help
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has an effect which empowers your basic attacks for a duration, further enhancing the attacks by granting you ( 150 / 100) bonus attack range and ( 75% / 40%) bonus attack speed while the effect is active.
augments.description_zh_TW: 在{{SpellName}}持續期間增加@RangeIncrease@攻擊距離和@ExtraAttackSpeed@攻速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在你的【{{SpellName}}】技能持续期间获得@RangeIncrease@攻击距离和@ExtraAttackSpeed@攻击速度。
augments.description_ja: {{SpellName}}の効果時間中は、通常攻撃の射程が@RangeIncrease@、攻撃速度が@ExtraAttackSpeed@増加する。
augments.description_ko: {{SpellName}} 지속시간 동안 공격 사거리가 @RangeIncrease@, 공격 속도가 @ExtraAttackSpeed@ 증가합니다.

augments.name: With Haste
augments.wikiDescription: Grants bonus movement speed equal to 70% ability haste.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得等同於技能加速@AbilityHasteToMSConversion*100@%的跑速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得移动速度，相当于你的@AbilityHasteToMSConversion*100@%技能急速。
augments.description_ja: スキルヘイストの@AbilityHasteToMSConversion*100@%にあたる移動速度を獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 스킬 가속의 @AbilityHasteToMSConversion*100@%에 해당하는 이동 속도를 얻습니다.

augments.name: Scopiest Weapons
augments.wikiDescription: Gain ( 250 / 150) bonus attack range.
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加@RangeIncrease@攻擊距離。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@RangeIncrease@攻击距离。
augments.description_ja: 射程距離が@RangeIncrease@増加する。
augments.description_ko: 공격 사거리가 @RangeIncrease@ 증가합니다.

augments.name: Donation
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 1750 upon acquiring this augment.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得@GoldAmount@金錢。別問那麼多。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@GoldAmount@金币。无需多问。
augments.description_ja: @GoldAmount@ゴールドを獲得する。それ以上も以下もない。
augments.description_ko: @GoldAmount@골드를 획득합니다. 묻지도 따지지도 않습니다.

augments.name: Siphon
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to heal you for 30% of its post-mitigation damage dealt to enemy champions.

augments.name: Outlaw's Grit
augments.wikiDescription: Dashing or blinking grants 12 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for 15 seconds, stacking up to 5 times for a total of 60 bonus resistances, and refreshing on subsequent triggers.
augments.description_zh_TW: 使用衝刺、閃現或傳送技能後，增加@ResistsPerStack@物防和魔防，最多@MaxStacks@層。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在使用一次冲刺、闪烁或传送之后，你获得@ResistsPerStack@护甲和魔法抗性，这个效果至多可叠加至@MaxStacks@层。
augments.description_ja: ダッシュ、ブリンク、またはテレポートを行うと、物理防御が@ResistsPerStack@と魔法防御が増加する。この効果は最大@MaxStacks@回スタックする。
augments.description_ko: 돌진, 점멸, 순간이동 스킬을 사용한 후 @ResistsPerStack@의 방어력 및 마법 저항력을 얻습니다. 최대 @MaxStacks@회 중첩됩니다.

augments.name: Scoped Weapons
augments.wikiDescription: Gain ( 75 / 50) bonus attack range.
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加@RangeIncrease@攻擊距離。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@RangeIncrease@攻击距离。
augments.description_ja: 射程距離が@RangeIncrease@増加する。
augments.description_ko: 공격 사거리가 @RangeIncrease@ 증가합니다.

augments.name: Swift and Safe
augments.wikiDescription: After dashing or blinking, gain a shield that lasts for 2 seconds and absorbs 65 – 290 (based on level) (+ 65% AD) (+ 26% AP) damage (5 second cooldown).

augments.name: Soul Eater
augments.wikiDescription: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants you 20 bonus health, stacking infinitely (5 second cooldown per cast instance). If this is not your first augment, gain 300 bonus health.
augments.description_zh_TW: 對敵方英雄造成硬控場後，獲得@HealthGainPerStack@最大生命。 若這是你拿的第二件增幅裝置，開始時有@StartingHPIfSecondAugmentTT@生命。
augments.description_zh_CN: 定身一个敌方英雄时会提供@HealthGainPerStack@最大生命值。 如果是你的第二个强化符文，会自带@StartingHPIfSecondAugmentTT@生命值。
augments.description_ja: 敵チャンピオンに移動不能効果を与えると、最大体力が@HealthGainPerStack@増加する。 2つ目のオーグメントとして入手した場合は、@StartingHPIfSecondAugmentTT@の体力で開始する。
augments.description_ko: 적 챔피언을 이동 불가 상태로 만들면 최대 체력을 @HealthGainPerStack@ 얻습니다. 두 번째 증강일 경우 @StartingHPIfSecondAugmentTT@의 체력으로 시작합니다.

augments.name: Homeguard
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 100% bonus movement speed. This bonus is lost for 6 seconds after taking damage from champions.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得@spell.Augment_Homeguard:MovementSpeed*100@%跑速，承受傷害後@spell.Augment_Homeguard:DisableCooldown@秒內會失效。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@spell.Augment_Homeguard:MovementSpeed*100@%移动速度，在受到伤害后失效@spell.Augment_Homeguard:DisableCooldown@秒。
augments.description_ja: 移動速度が@spell.Augment_Homeguard:MovementSpeed*100@%増加し、ダメージを受けると@spell.Augment_Homeguard:DisableCooldown@秒間無効化される。
augments.description_ko: 이동 속도가 @spell.Augment_Homeguard:MovementSpeed*100@% 증가합니다. 피해를 입은 후 @spell.Augment_Homeguard:DisableCooldown@초 동안은 효과가 멈춥니다.

augments.name: Marksmage
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 75% AP.
augments.description_zh_TW: 你的普攻造成等同於@APRatio*100@%魔攻的額外物理傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的攻击造成相当于你@APRatio*100@%法术强度的额外物理伤害。
augments.description_ja: 通常攻撃が魔力の@APRatio*100@%にあたる物理ダメージを追加で与える。
augments.description_ko: 기본 공격 시 주문력의 @APRatio*100@%만큼 추가 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

augments.name: Final Form
augments.wikiDescription: Casting your ultimate ability empowers you for 10 seconds, causing you to gain a shield for 50% of your maximum health, 20% omnivamp, and 30% bonus movement speed for the duration (20 second cooldown).
augments.description_zh_TW: 施放大絕後，獲得最大生命護盾、全能吸血以及跑速，持續@AugDuration@秒。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在施放你的终极技能时，获得持续@AugDuration@秒的最大生命值护盾、全能吸血和移动速度。
augments.description_ja: アルティメット使用後、@AugDuration@秒間、最大体力に応じたシールドとオムニヴァンプを獲得し、移動速度が増加する。
augments.description_ko: 궁극기를 사용하면 @AugDuration@초 동안 최대 체력 비례 보호막, 모든 피해 흡혈, 이동 속도를 얻습니다.

augments.name: Typhoon
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks launch a missile at a nearby enemy, prioritizing champions, that deals 30% AD physical damage and applies on-hit effects.
augments.description_zh_TW: 普攻會朝額外一名目標射出飛彈，造成較低傷害，並附加{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的攻击会对一个额外目标发射一个飞弹，从而造成削减过的伤害并施加{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}。
augments.description_ja: 通常攻撃で追加の対象1体に向けてミサイルを発射し、一定割合低下したダメージを与えて、{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}を適用する。
augments.description_ko: 기본 공격 시 추가 대상에게 투사체를 발사해 감소된 피해를 입히고 {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} 효과를 적용합니다.

augments.name: Big Brain
augments.wikiDescription: Gain a shield that absorbs damage equal to 300% AP and lasts until destroyed. Shield is replenished upon respawn and every 70 seconds.
augments.description_zh_TW: 每有%i:scaleAP% @AP@魔攻增加@ShieldBase@護盾。在死亡或護盾耗盡後70秒重置。
augments.description_zh_CN: 每拥有%i:scaleAP%@AP@法术强度就会获得@ShieldBase@护盾值。阵亡时或耗尽后70秒重置。
augments.description_ja: %i:scaleAP%魔力@AP@ごとに、耐久値@ShieldBase@のシールドを獲得する。自身が倒された場合、またはシールドの耐久値がなくなってから70秒経過するとリセットされる。
augments.description_ko: %i:scaleAP% 주문력 @AP@당 @ShieldBase@의 피해를 흡수하는 보호막을 얻습니다. 사망 시 또는 만료 70초 후 초기화됩니다.

augments.name: Upgrade Zhonya's

names.ja: ゾーニャ アップグレード

augments.name_ja: ゾーニャ アップグレード
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades Seeker's Armguard, Wooglet's Witchcap, and Zhonya's Hourglass, empowering Stasis to cleanse you of all crowd control and allow you to move during its active effect, during which time you also gain 50% bonus movement speed. Additionally, the cooldown of Zhonya's Hourglass' Stasis is reduced to 45 seconds. The active cannot be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control despite cleansing the user.
augments.description_zh_TW: 將中婭沙漏的冷卻時間縮短至@UpgradeCD@秒。你現在處於中婭沙漏、探索者護腕或烏莉特的法帽的凝滯狀態時可以移動且增加跑速。 獲得250金錢。
augments.description_zh_CN: 【中娅沙漏】的冷却时间降低至@UpgradeCD@秒。你现在可以在【中娅沙漏】、【探索者的护臂】或【沃格勒特的巫师帽】凝滞状态持续期间移动并获得移动速度。 获得250金币。
augments.description_ja: 「ゾーニャの砂時計」のクールダウンが@UpgradeCD@秒に短縮される。「ゾーニャの砂時計」、「シーカー アームガード」あるいは「ウーグレット ウィッチキャップ」の固有時停止状態中に動くことができ、移動速度が上昇する。 250ゴールドを獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 존야의 모래시계 재사용 대기시간이 @UpgradeCD@초로 감소합니다. 이제 존야의 모래시계, 추적자의 팔목 보호대 또는 우글렛의 마녀모자 경직 상태에서 이동할 수 있으며 이동 속도가 증가합니다. 250골드를 획득합니다.

augments.name: Terrain'd
augments.wikiDescription: Your chosen ability deals damage in an area around it.

augments.name: Recursion
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 60 ability haste.
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加@AbilityHaste@技能加速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@AbilityHaste@技能急速。
augments.description_ja: スキルヘイストが@AbilityHaste@増加する。
augments.description_ko: 스킬 가속이 @AbilityHaste@ 증가합니다.

augments.description_zh_TW: 雪球增加@Haste@技能加速。 你的雪球超大且會穿過士兵。雪球會緩速、擊飛英雄並造成額外傷害。 若你沒有雪球就會獲得一顆雪球。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的雪球获得@Haste@技能急速。 你的雪球现在变得非常大，并且可以穿过小兵。它会减速， 击飞英雄，并造成额外伤害。 如果你没有雪球，则获得一个雪球。
augments.description_ja: 雪玉のスキルヘイストが@Haste@増加する。 雪玉は大きくなり、ミニオンを通り抜ける。チャンピオンにスロウ効果を与えてノックアップし、追加ダメージを与える。 まだ持っていない場合は、雪玉を1個獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 눈덩이의 스킬 가속이 @Haste@만큼 증가합니다. 눈덩이가 거대해지고 미니언을 관통합니다. 눈덩이는 챔피언을 둔화시키고, 공중에 띄우며, 피해를 추가로 입힙니다. 눈덩이를 보유하지 않은 경우 눈덩이를 얻습니다.

augments.name: Omni Soul
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 3 random Dragon Souls.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得@SoulsToAdd@種隨機龍魂。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@SoulsToAdd@个随机龙魂。
augments.description_ja: ランダムなドラゴンソウルを@SoulsToAdd@個獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 무작위 드래곤 영혼 @SoulsToAdd@개를 획득합니다.

augments.name: All For You
augments.wikiDescription: Your heals and shields on allied champions are increased in effectiveness by 30%.
augments.description_zh_TW: 對友軍使用時，你的治療和護盾效果提升。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的治疗和护盾在用在一个友军身上时会变强。
augments.description_ja: 味方に対する体力回復効果とシールドが強化される。
augments.description_ko: 아군에게 사용하는 체력 회복 및 보호막 효과가 증가합니다.

augments.name: Don't Change the Channel
augments.name_ja: チャンネルはそのまま
augments.wikiDescription: Gain a Shield for every second you spend Channeling.

augments.name: Don't Blink
augments.wikiDescription: Deal 1% increased damage per 10 movement speed you have more than the target.
augments.description_zh_TW: 每高出目標10跑速，傷害便增加@BonusDamagePerMSDifference*1000@%。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你每比目标多10移动速度，则对其多造成@BonusDamagePerMSDifference*1000@%额外伤害。
augments.description_ja: 自身の移動速度が敵を上回っている場合、対象に追加ダメージを与える(移動速度差10につき、@BonusDamagePerMSDifference*1000@%の追加ダメージ)。
augments.description_ko: 대상보다 이동 속도가 10 높을 때마다 추가 피해량이 @BonusDamagePerMSDifference*1000@% 증가합니다.

augments.name: Overextender
augments.wikiDescription: Your launch with the Cannon Launcher is now empowered, increasing the launch range by 12,000 units and the impact damage by 50%, as well as the travel speed by a significant amount. Additionally, your Recall is now functional and is upgraded to Empowered Recall. Total launch range is 18,500 units, reduced to 16,500 after your team's Outer turret is destroyed. Increased impact damage is 180 – 690 (based on level) magic damage.
augments.description_zh_TW: 回城進入你的砲擊發射器。它的射程、砲彈速度和傷害都大幅提升。
augments.description_zh_CN: 回城并进入到你的加农炮发射器。它的距离、飞行速度和伤害已经得到显著提升。
augments.description_ja: リコールで「キャノンランチャー」に入る。射程、移動速度、ダメージが大幅に増加する。
augments.description_ko: 귀환하여 대포 발사기에 탑승하세요. 발사기의 사거리, 이동 속도, 피해량이 대폭 증가했습니다.

augments.name: It's Go Time
augments.wikiDescription: Activating your chosen ability grants you Movement Speed for its duration.

augments.name: Trusty Weapon
augments.wikiDescription: Striking enemy champions with your chosen ability forges a bond of Friendship. your chosen ability gains temporarily increased damage based on your level of Friendship.

augments.name: Minionmancer
augments.wikiDescription: Your pets deal 40% increased damage as well as gain 40% bonus health and size.
augments.description_zh_TW: 你的召喚物增加@MinionAmp*100@%體型、生命與傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的召唤物获得@MinionAmp*100@%体型提升、生命值和伤害。
augments.description_ja: 自身が召喚したユニットのサイズ、体力、ダメージが@MinionAmp*100@%増加する。
augments.description_ko: 소환물의 크기, 체력, 피해량이 @MinionAmp*100@% 증가합니다.

augments.name: Ravenous Bind
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a immobilizing or grounding effect, empowering the ability to deal 15 – 90 (based on level) (+ 10% AP) (+ 0.5% of your maximum health) magic damage to affected targets and heal you for 50 – 200 (based on level) (+ 5% AP) (+ 10% bonus health). The heal is increased by up to 50% based on how long the ability's cooldown is.
augments.description_zh_TW: 以{{SpellName}}對敵方英雄施加硬控場或禁錮時造成額外傷害，並使你回復生命。
augments.description_zh_CN: 用你的【{{SpellName}}】技能定身或缚地敌方英雄时造成额外伤害并对你进行治疗。
augments.description_ja: {{SpellName}}で敵チャンピオンに移動不能効果または釘付け効果を付与すると、追加ダメージを与えて自身の体力を回復する。
augments.description_ko: {{SpellName}} 스킬로 적 챔피언을 이동 불가 상태로 만들거나 이동 스킬을 사용할 수 없게 하면 추가 피해를 입히고 체력을 회복합니다.

augments.name: Dashing
augments.wikiDescription: Abilities with dashes or blinks gain 175 ability haste. On Kalista, this augment instead grants her 125% bonus attack speed.[1]
augments.description_zh_TW: 衝刺、跳躍、閃現或傳送技能獲得@Haste@技能加速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的冲刺、跳跃、闪烁或传送类技能获得@Haste@技能急速。
augments.description_ja: ダッシュ、リープ、ブリンク、またはテレポートを行うスキルのスキルヘイストが@Haste@増加する。
augments.description_ko: 돌진, 도약, 점멸, 순간이동 스킬의 스킬 가속이 @Haste@만큼 증가합니다.

augments.name: Transmute: Chaos
augments.wikiDescription: Gain two completely random augments, excluding the other two offerings in your current assortment.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得@AugmentsToGrantToolTipOnly@件隨機%i:Augment%增幅裝置。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@AugmentsToGrantToolTipOnly@个随机%i:Augment%强化符文。
augments.description_ja: ランダムな%i:Augment%オーグメントを@AugmentsToGrantToolTipOnly@個獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 무작위 %i:Augment%증강 @AugmentsToGrantToolTipOnly@개를 획득합니다.

augments.name: En Passant
augments.wikiDescription: You can now identify the Vitals of enemy champions within 2000 units, marked as an arc around them and pointing towards a specific direction. Dealing damage to a target with a basic attack or ability while you are facing in the direction of their exposed Vital will consume it, dealing bonus true damage equal to 6% (+ 1.5% per En Passant stack) of the target's maximum health, healing you for 50 – 200 (based on level) (+ 5% missing health), and granting you 50% (+ 5% per En Passant stack) bonus movement speed that decays over 2 seconds. Consuming a target's Vital also grants you an En Passant stack for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent Vital triggers and stacking up a number of times. Each En Passant stack increases the consumed Vital damage and bonus movement speed. Vitals on targets become exposed instantly once you are within range and remain exposed until you die. Once a target's Vital is consumed, you identify a new Vital on them pointing in a different direction from the previous after 4 seconds.
augments.description_zh_TW: 定期找出敵方英雄的破綻。用普攻或技能擊中破綻時，造成最大生命的真實傷害、回復自身生命並增加跑速。這些效果可累加。
augments.description_zh_CN: 周期性地识别出敌方英雄身上的破绽。 用攻击或技能命中它们时，会造成最大生命值真实伤害、回复生命值并提供移动速度。这些效果可以叠加。
augments.description_ja: 時々、敵チャンピオンの「急所」が明らかになる。通常攻撃かスキルが「急所」に命中すると、対象の最大体力に応じた確定ダメージを与え、自身の体力を回復し、移動速度が増加する。この効果はスタックする。
augments.description_ko: 주기적으로 적 챔피언의 급소를 파악합니다. 급소를 기본 공격 또는 스킬로 타격하면 최대 체력 비례 고정 피해를 입히고, 체력을 회복하며, 이동 속도가 증가합니다. 이 효과는 중첩될 수 있습니다.

augments.name: Bread and Cheese
augments.wikiDescription: Your champion's third basic ability (E) gains 100 ability haste.
augments.description_zh_TW: 你的{{SpellName}}獲得@EAbilityHaste@技能加速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的【{{SpellName}}】技能获得@EAbilityHaste@技能急速。
augments.description_ja: {{SpellName}}のスキルヘイストが@EAbilityHaste@増加する。
augments.description_ko: {{SpellName}} 스킬 가속이 @EAbilityHaste@ 증가합니다.

augments.name: Goldrend
augments.wikiDescription: Damaging basic attacks or abilities against enemy champions deal 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 40% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) bonus magic damage, and grant you 30 and 25% bonus movement speed for 1.5 seconds (30 second cooldown per champion).
augments.description_zh_TW: 以普攻或技能傷害英雄時，造成額外魔法傷害，並獲得金錢和跑速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 用攻击或技能对一个英雄造成伤害时会造成额外魔法伤害，并为你提供金币和 移动速度。
augments.description_ja: チャンピオンに通常攻撃かスキルでダメージを与えると追加魔法ダメージを与え、ゴールドを獲得して、移動速度が増加する。
augments.description_ko: 기본 공격이나 스킬로 챔피언에게 피해를 입히면 추가 마법 피해를 입히고 골드를 획득하며 이동 속도가 증가합니다.

augments.name: It's Killing Time
augments.wikiDescription: Upon casting your ultimate ability, you apply Zed's Death Mark to all enemy champions (8 second cooldown). The mark stores 40% of all post-mitigation damage you deal to the affected target, detonating after 5 seconds to deal true damage equal to the damage stored against them.
augments.description_zh_TW: 施放大絕後，標記所有敵軍，並儲存你對目標造成的傷害。倒數結束時，引爆傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在施放你的终极技能后，标记所有敌人并存储你对他们造成的伤害。当它结束时，引爆该伤害。
augments.description_ja: アルティメットスキル発動後、すべての敵にマークを付与し、マークした敵に与えたダメージを蓄える。アルティメットスキル終了時、蓄えたダメージを解き放つ。
augments.description_ko: 궁극기 사용 후 모든 적에게 표식을 남깁니다. 표식은 대상에게 입히는 피해를 비축합니다. 표식이 사라지면 비축한 피해를 폭발시킵니다.

augments.name: Urf's Champion

names.ja: アーフのチャンピオン

augments.name_ja: アーフのチャンピオン
augments.wikiDescription: Quest: Score 18 champion takedowns. Reward: Upon completing your Quest, you receive The Golden Spatula. If your inventory is full at the time of quest completion, the item will be granted as soon as a slot in the inventory is available. The Golden Spatula Attack damage changed to 90. Ability power changed to 110. Attack speed changed to 40%. Armor changed to 20. Magic resistance changed to 20. Movement speed changed to 10%. Critical strike chance changed to 15%. Health changed to 200. Base health regeneration changed to 50%. Mana changed to 200. Base mana regeneration changed to 100%. Life steal changed to 10%. Unique Passive - Doing Something: Burn radius changed to 400 units. Increased mana regeneration changed to 10%. Increased energy regeneration changed to 20%. Removed: No longer reduces the remaining cooldowns of your abilities by 0.2 seconds every 0.25 seconds.
augments.description_zh_TW: 任務：參與擊殺@QuestRequirement@次。 獎勵：黃金鍋鏟。
augments.description_zh_CN: 任务：参与击杀@QuestRequirement@次。 奖励：金铲铲
augments.description_ja: クエスト: キルまたはアシストを@QuestRequirement@回獲得する。 報酬: 「金のへら」を獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 퀘스트: 처치 관여를 @QuestRequirement@회 달성해야 합니다. 보상: 황금 뒤집개

augments.name: Apex Inventor
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 100 item haste, which is equivalent to 50% cooldown reduction for items.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得@ItemHaste@道具加速(等同於@TooltipCDR@%道具冷卻時間減免)。 道具加速會縮短所有道具技能的冷卻時間%i:cooldown%。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@ItemHaste@装备急速(相当于@TooltipCDR@%装备冷却缩减)。 装备急速可缩减所有装备技能的冷却时间%i:cooldown%。
augments.description_ja: アイテムヘイストが@ItemHaste@増加する(アイテムクールダウン短縮@TooltipCDR@%に相当)。 アイテムヘイストはすべてのアイテムスキルのクールダウン%i:cooldown%を短縮する。
augments.description_ko: 아이템 가속이 @ItemHaste@ 증가합니다. (@TooltipCDR@%의 아이템 재사용 대기시간 감소 효과와 동일) 아이템 가속은 모든 아이템 스킬의 재사용 대기시간%i:cooldown%을 감소시킵니다.

augments.name: Cruelty
augments.wikiDescription: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion summons a comet above them that lands at their current location after 1 second, dealing 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 40% AP) (+ 4% of your maximum health) magic damage to enemies within a 300 radius (6 second cooldown per cast instance). For displacement effects, the comet will be summoned at the displacement's end location.
augments.description_zh_TW: 硬控場或禁錮英雄時，召喚一顆於短暫延遲後墜落的彗星，對鄰近敵軍造成魔法傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 定身或缚地一个英雄时，召唤一颗会在短暂延迟后着陆的彗星，对附近的敌人们造成魔法伤害。
augments.description_ja: チャンピオンに移動不能効果か釘付け効果を与えると彗星が召喚される。彗星は少ししてから落下して、周囲の敵に魔法ダメージを与える。
augments.description_ko: 챔피언을 이동 불가 상태로 만들거나 이동 스킬을 사용할 수 없게 하면 혜성을 소환합니다. 혜성은 잠시 후 떨어지며, 주변 적에게 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

augments.name: Master of Duality
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks on-hit grant 6 – 18 (based on level) ability power and damaging abilities once per cast instance grant 3 – 9 (based on level) bonus attack damage, lasting for 5 seconds, with the duration of both refreshing on subsequent hits, and stacking infinitely.
augments.description_zh_TW: 普攻可累加魔攻，傷害技能則可增加物攻。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的每次攻击为你提供可叠加的法术强度，并且你的每次技能在伤害敌人时为你提供可叠加的攻击力。
augments.description_ja: 通常攻撃で魔力の増加スタック、スキルで敵にダメージを与えると攻撃力の増加スタックを獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 기본 공격 시 중첩되는 주문력을 얻고 스킬로 적에게 피해를 입히면 공격력을 얻습니다.

augments.name: Empowered By The Faithful
augments.wikiDescription: Granting a heal or shield to an allied champion blesses them for 8 seconds. Whenever a blessed ally damages an enemy champion, you generate a stack of Devotion, stacking up to 50 times. Upon reaching maximum stacks, you unleash a shockwave that deals 50 – 300 (based on level) (+ 750% heal and shield power) magic damage to nearby enemies. Enemy champions damaged below a percentage of their maximum health equal to 25% of your heal and shield power are executed.
augments.description_zh_TW: 給予友軍治療或護盾時會祝福對方；他們對敵軍造成傷害時，你會獲得信仰。 累積足夠信仰時，便會發出衝擊波，造成魔法傷害並處決低生命的敵軍。
augments.description_zh_CN: 为友军提供治疗或护盾会赐福他们，使其伤害填充你的虔诚。 当你拥有足够的虔诚时，释放一道冲击波来造成魔法伤害并处决低生命值的敌人们。
augments.description_ja: 味方に体力回復効果またはシールドを付与すると、その味方に「祝福」を与える。祝福された味方が与えるダメージに応じて献身を獲得する。 献身が十分に溜まると、衝撃波を放って敵に魔法ダメージを与え、体力が低下した敵にとどめを刺す。
augments.description_ko: 아군을 상대로 체력을 회복시키거나 보호막을 씌우면 대상을 축복합니다. 축복받은 아군이 피해를 입히면 헌신이 차오릅니다. 헌신을 충분히 모으면 충격파를 내보내 마법 피해를 입히고 체력이 낮은 적을 처형합니다.

augments.name: Courage of the Colossus
augments.wikiDescription: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants a shield for 3 seconds that absorbs 150 – 450 (based on level) (+ 4% maximum health) damage (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Shields can stack between multiple triggers of this effect, though not refreshing the duration of previous shields.
augments.description_zh_TW: 在硬控場或禁錮敵方英雄後獲得@TotalShield@護盾。
augments.description_zh_CN: 定身或缚地一个敌方英雄后获得@TotalShield@护盾值。
augments.description_ja: 敵チャンピオンに移動不能効果か釘付け効果を与えると耐久値@TotalShield@のシールドを獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 적 챔피언을 이동 불가 상태로 만들거나 이동 스킬을 사용할 수 없게 하면 @TotalShield@의 보호막을 얻습니다.

augments.name: Hextech Soul

names.ja: ヘクステック ソウル

augments.name_ja: ヘクステック ソウル
augments.wikiDescription: Grants the Hextech Dragon Soul, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.
augments.description_zh_TW: 每過一段時間，下一次傷害性技能或普攻會對附近敵人觸發連鎖的閃電炸裂，造成傷害與緩速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 周期性地使你的下一个伤害型技能或攻击触发一道闪电爆裂，连锁穿过敌人以造成伤害和减速。
augments.description_ja: 一定時間ごとに、次に敵へダメージを与えるスキルまたは通常攻撃が稲妻の爆発を引き起こす。稲妻は敵に連鎖してダメージを与え、スロウ効果を与える。
augments.description_ko: 주기적으로 스킬 또는 기본 공격으로 피해를 입히면 번개를 발사해 적에게 연쇄적으로 피해를 입히고 둔화시킵니다.

augments.name: Yowch, My Coins!
augments.wikiDescription: Enemy champions that you score a takedown against drop 6 – 10 (based on level) coins, with each coin landing 500 units away from the location of their death and lasting 10 seconds. You or allied champions can collect the coins by moving over them, granting 15 for each coin collected.
augments.description_zh_TW: 參與擊殺敵方英雄時，敵方英雄會在附近掉落金幣，供你和隊友撿取。每枚金幣值@GoldPerCoin@金錢。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在参与击杀敌方英雄后，该英雄会在附近掉落多枚硬币，你和友军可以收集它们。每枚硬币价值@GoldPerCoin@金币。
augments.description_ja: キルまたはアシストを獲得すると、敵チャンピオンがコインを付近にドロップする。コインは自身も味方も回収できる。コイン1枚は@GoldPerCoin@ゴールドに相当する。
augments.description_ko: 처치 관여 시 적 챔피언이 주변에 자신과 아군이 주울 수 있는 동전을 떨어뜨립니다. 각 동전은 @GoldPerCoin@골드의 가치를 지닙니다.

augments.name: Endless Decimation
augments.wikiDescription: While in combat, automatically cast an improved version of Darius' Decimate, winding up over 1.25 seconds to slash in a 460 radius around you. The slash deals 100 – 400 (based on level) (+ 60% AD) (+ 40% AP) physical damage to enemies within the area (8 second cooldown). Enemies within the 240 inner radius of the slash take「 50% damage. 」「 50 – 200 (based on level) (+ 30% AD) (+ 20% AP) physical damage. 」Additionally, for each enemy champion hit along the outer edge, you heal for 18% of your missing health and the cooldown of this effect is reduced by 10%, down to a minimum of 3 seconds.
augments.description_zh_TW: 戰鬥時，自動施放圓形斧擊，造成物理傷害。外圈的敵軍會受到額外傷害，並讓你回復生命。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在战斗状态下，自动施放一次环形斧头挥舞从而造成物理伤害。被斧刃命中的敌人们受到额外伤害并治疗你。
augments.description_ja: 戦闘中、自動発動で円を描くように斧を振り回し、物理ダメージを与える。外縁部にいる敵には追加ダメージを与え、自身の体力を回復する。
augments.description_ko: 전투 중 자동 사용으로 도끼를 원형으로 휘둘러 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 바깥쪽 칼날에 적 적중 시 추가 피해를 입히고 체력을 회복합니다.

augments.name: Ultimate Awakening
augments.wikiDescription: Casting your ultimate ability resets the cooldowns of all your basic abilities and grants you 300 basic ability haste for 15 seconds (20 second cooldown). Additionally, gain 30 ultimate haste.
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加@AH@大絕加速。 施放大絕後，重置基礎技能並增加@AdditionalHaste@基礎技能加速，持續@BuffDuration@秒(冷卻時間@Cooldown@秒)。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@AH@终极技能急速。 在施放你的终极技能后，刷新你的所有基础技能并获得持续@BuffDuration@秒的@AdditionalHaste@基础技能急速。(@Cooldown@秒冷却时间)
augments.description_ja: アルティメットスキルヘイストが@AH@増加する。 アルティメットスキルを使用すると、通常スキルのクールダウンが解消し、@BuffDuration@秒間、通常スキルヘイストが@AdditionalHaste@増加する(クールダウン@Cooldown@秒)。
augments.description_ko: 궁극기 가속이 @AH@ 증가합니다. 궁극기 사용 시 기본 스킬이 초기화되고 @BuffDuration@초 동안 기본 스킬 가속이 @AdditionalHaste@ 증가합니다. (재사용 대기시간 @Cooldown@초)

augments.name: Overloaded
augments.wikiDescription: Using another Ability resets the cooldown of your chosen ability.

augments.name: Adaptive Ward
augments.wikiDescription: Striking an enemy champion with your chosen ability grants you the required number of Armor or Magic Resist based on their damage type for the required number of seconds. This effect can stack.

augments.name: Stats!
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 2 Stat Anvils.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得@AmountOfStatAnvils@塊%i:StatAnvil%能力值鐵砧！
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@AmountOfStatAnvils@个%i:StatAnvil%【属性锻造器】！
augments.description_ja: 「%i:StatAnvil%ステータスの金床」を@AmountOfStatAnvils@個獲得する。
augments.description_ko: %i:StatAnvil% 능력치 모루를 @AmountOfStatAnvils@개 획득합니다.

augments.name: Bread And Butter
augments.wikiDescription: Your champion's first basic ability (Q) gains 100 ability haste.
augments.description_zh_TW: 你的@spell1KeyBind@獲得@QAbilityHaste@技能加速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的@spell1KeyBind@获得@QAbilityHaste@技能急速。
augments.description_ja: @spell1KeyBind@のスキルヘイストが@QAbilityHaste@増加する。
augments.description_ko: @spell1KeyBind@ 스킬 가속을 @QAbilityHaste@ 얻습니다.

augments.name: Ominous Pact
augments.wikiDescription: Your abilities now have a health cost of 5% current health to cast them. In return, you gain ability power based on your missing health, up to 75 – 150 (based on level) at 70% missing health, 0% – 50% (based on missing health) bonus movement speed, and 0% – 20% (based on missing health) omnivamp.
augments.description_zh_TW: 根據已損失生命獲得魔攻、跑速和全能吸血，每次施放技能都會受到傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 基于已损失生命值，获得法术强度、移动速度和全能吸血，每次你施放技能时会对自身造成伤害。
augments.description_ja: 減少体力に応じて、魔力、移動速度およびオムニヴァンプが増加し、スキルを使用するたびにダメージを受ける。
augments.description_ko: 잃은 체력에 비례하여 주문력, 이동 속도, 모든 피해 흡혈을 얻지만, 스킬을 사용할 때마다 피해를 입습니다.

augments.name: Infernal Soul

names.ja: インファーナルソウル

augments.name_ja: インファーナルソウル
augments.wikiDescription: Grants the Infernal Dragon Soul, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得赤燄龍魂，使用技能或普攻命中敵軍時，造成額外傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你获得炼狱龙魂，使用技能或攻击命中敌人时造成额外伤害。
augments.description_ja: 「インファーナルドラゴンソウル」を獲得し、敵にスキルまたは通常攻撃を命中させた際、追加ダメージを与える。
augments.description_ko: 스킬 또는 기본 공격으로 적을 공격할 때마다 추가 피해를 입히는 화염의 드래곤 영혼을 얻습니다.

augments.name: Bolstered
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a shield effect, increasing the strength of the ability's shield by 0% – 60% (based on target's missing health).
augments.description_zh_TW: {{SpellName}}賦予的護盾量增強，且會隨目標的已損失生命而提升。
augments.description_zh_CN: 来自【{{SpellName}}】技能的护盾变得更强并且受益于目标的已损失生命值。
augments.description_ja: {{SpellName}}から付与されるシールドが強化され、対象の減少体力に応じて効果が増加する。
augments.description_ko: {{SpellName}} 스킬로 부여되는 보호막이 더 강력해지며, 효과가 대상 잃은 체력에 비례합니다.

augments.name: Stats on Stats on Stats!

names.ja: ステータス上のステータス上のステータス！

augments.name_ja: ステータス上のステータス上のステータス！
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 4 Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of obtaining Gold- and Prismatic-tier anvils. Additionally, on the next round of augment selection, you gain an additional reroll per augment slot.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得@AmountOfStatAnvils@塊%i:StatAnvil%能力值鐵砧！
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@AmountOfStatAnvils@个%i:StatAnvil%【属性锻造器】！
augments.description_ja: 「%i:StatAnvil%ステータスの金床」を@AmountOfStatAnvils@個獲得する。
augments.description_ko: %i:StatAnvil% 능력치 모루를 @AmountOfStatAnvils@개 획득합니다.

augments.name: Ok Boomerang
augments.wikiDescription: Automatically cast an improved version of Sivir's Boomerang Blade at the closest nearby enemy champion within 1250 units, dealing 40 – 200 (based on level) (+ 30% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) adaptive damage to enemies hit (10 second cooldown).
augments.description_zh_TW: 每@Cooldown@秒自動施放對鄰近敵軍發射回力鏢。
augments.description_zh_CN: 每@Cooldown@秒朝着一个附近的敌人自动施放投掷一个回力镖。
augments.description_ja: @Cooldown@秒ごとに、近くの敵1体に対してブーメランが自動発動で発射される。
augments.description_ko: 자동 사용 @Cooldown@초마다 근처 적에게 부메랑을 던집니다.

augments.name: Mercy's Strike
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to enhance your next basic attack. The enhanced attack has 300 bonus range, gains 75% bonus attack speed, and deals bonus magic damage equal to 3% (+ 2% per 10% heal and shield power) of the target's maximum health. If the target is a turret, the damage is modified to 2.5% of the target's maximum health bonus magic damage.
augments.description_zh_TW: 使用{{SpellName}}治療或給予護盾友軍後，你的下一次普攻將增加攻擊距離和攻速，並造成額外最大生命魔法傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在使用【{{SpellName}}】技能为你的友军提供治疗或护盾之后，你的下一次普攻获得攻击距离、攻击速度并造成额外最大生命值魔法伤害。
augments.description_ja: {{SpellName}}で味方に体力回復効果またはシールドを付与すると、次の通常攻撃の射程と攻撃速度が増加し、最大体力に応じた魔法ダメージを追加で与える。
augments.description_ko: {{SpellName}} 스킬로 아군의 체력을 회복시키거나 보호막을 부여하면 다음 기본 공격 시 공격 사거리와 공격 속도가 증가하고 추가로 최대 체력 비례 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

augments.name: Circle of Death
augments.wikiDescription: Healing and health regeneration you do causes you to deal 70% of that value in magic damage to the nearest enemy champion within 1000 units.
augments.description_zh_TW: 施展治療和生命回復時，也會對最靠近的敵方英雄造成魔法傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 治疗效果和生命回复效果还会对相距最近的那个敌方英雄造成魔法伤害。
augments.description_ja: 体力を回復または自動回復すると、最も近くにいる敵チャンピオンに、魔法ダメージとして与える。
augments.description_ko: 체력을 회복하거나 체력을 재생하면 가장 가까운 적 챔피언에게 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

augments.name: Bread And Jam
augments.wikiDescription: Your champion's second basic ability (W) gains 100 ability haste.
augments.description_zh_TW: 你的{{SpellName}}獲得@WAbilityHaste@技能加速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的【{{SpellName}}】技能获得@WAbilityHaste@技能急速。
augments.description_ja: {{SpellName}}のスキルヘイストが@WAbilityHaste@増加する。
augments.description_ko: {{SpellName}} 스킬 가속이 @WAbilityHaste@ 증가합니다.

augments.name: Thread the Needle
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 18% armor penetration and magic penetration.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得@PercentPen*100@%%i:scaleAPen%物理穿透與%i:scaleMPen%魔法穿透。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@PercentPen*100@%%i:scaleAPen%护甲穿透和%i:scaleMPen%法术穿透。
augments.description_ja: %i:scaleAPen%物理防御貫通と%i:scaleMPen%魔法防御貫通が@PercentPen*100@%増加する。
augments.description_ko: %i:scaleAPen% 방어구 관통력 및 %i:scaleMPen% 마법 관통력 @PercentPen*100@%를 얻습니다.

augments.name: Searing Dawn
augments.wikiDescription: Gain Leona's Sunlight. Sunlight: Your damaging abilities mark enemies, causing them to take 40 – 200 (based on level) bonus magic damage from your ally's next basic attack or ability hit against them (0.75-second cooldown per target).
augments.description_zh_TW: 技能會標記敵軍，友軍的下一次普攻或技能會對其造成額外魔法傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的技能会标记敌人，使其在被你的友军的下一个攻击或技能命中时会受到额外魔法伤害。
augments.description_ja: スキルが敵をマークする。味方はマークされた敵に対し、次の通常攻撃またはスキルで追加の魔法ダメージを与える。
augments.description_ko: 스킬이 적에게 표식을 남깁니다. 적은 아군의 다음 기본 공격 또는 스킬로부터 마법 피해를 추가로 입습니다.

augments.name: Shark Bait
augments.wikiDescription: Upon taking fatal damage, you become a Shark Bait, causing you to enter a zombie state for 3.5 seconds, during which your movement speed is set to a static 400, you gain ghosting, and enemies within 400 units of you are slowed by 40%. At the end of the duration, a massive shark emerges from beneath you that lets out a powerful chomp (400 radius), dealing 120 – 350 (based on level) (+ 30% of target's missing health) magic damage to all enemies within the area and knocking them up for 1 second. While under the zombie state, you are able to move and become invulnerable, untargetable, and immune to crowd control, but you are also rendered unable to declare basic attacks, cast abilities, use summoner spells, and activate items.
augments.description_zh_TW: 死亡後幾秒內，鯊魚會撕咬所有鄰近敵軍。你在死亡後可以透過移動瞄準鯊魚攻擊。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在阵亡之后的若干秒，一头鲨鱼会啃噬所有附近的敌人们。你可以在阵亡后进行移动，以给鲨鱼攻击进行定位。
augments.description_ja: デスしてから数秒後に、サメが周囲のすべての敵に噛みつく。デス後も移動してサメの攻撃の狙いを定めることができる。
augments.description_ko: 사망 몇 초 후 상어가 주변 모든 적을 물어뜯습니다. 사망 후에도 이동하여 상어 공격의 대상을 정할 수 있습니다.

augments.name: Divine Intervention
augments.wikiDescription: Automatically cast Taric's Cosmic Radiance, calling down a protective star upon you that descends over 2.5 seconds. Afterwards, you and all allied champions within 400 units become invulnerable for 2.5 seconds (35 second cooldown).
augments.description_zh_TW: 戰鬥開始後不久，召喚一顆守護星。守護星落地時，你和附近的友軍獲得幾秒鐘的無敵狀態。 隨後每隔@BaseCD@秒自動施放一次。
augments.description_zh_CN: 战斗开始后的短时间内，召唤一颗护体星星。在它着陆时，你和附近的友军们进入持续若干秒的免疫伤害状态。 随后每@BaseCD@秒自动施放这个效果。
augments.description_ja: 戦闘開始から少し経つと、守護星を召喚する。星が落下すると、自身および周囲の味方が数秒間無敵状態になる。 その後は@BaseCD@秒ごとに自動発動する。
augments.description_ko: 전투 시작 직후, 보호의 별을 소환합니다. 별이 착지하면 자신과 주변 아군이 몇 초 동안 무적 상태가 됩니다. 이후 @BaseCD@초마다 자동 사용합니다.

augments.name: Symphony of War
augments.wikiDescription: Gain the Conqueror and Lethal Tempo keystone runes. Conqueror Adaptive force per stack changed to 1.8 – 3.3 (based on level) bonus Attack Damage or 3 – 5.5 (based on level) Ability Power (Adaptive). Healing changed to ( 10% / 8%) of damage dealt. Lethal Tempo Bonus attack speed per stack changed to ( 13% – 18% / 8% – 12%) (based on level). Maximum bonus attack speed changed to ( 78% – 108% / 48% – 72%) (based on level). Removed: No longer empowers basic attacks at maximum stacks to fire a bolt that deals bonus adaptive damage. New Effect: At maximum stacks, gain 50 bonus attack range and increase the attack speed cap to 10.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得致命節奏與征服者關鍵符文。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得致命节奏和征服者基石符文。
augments.description_ja: キーストーンルーンの「リーサルテンポ」と「征服者」を獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 치명적 속도와 정복자 핵심 룬을 얻습니다.

augments.name: Ultimate Revolution
augments.wikiDescription: Casting your ultimate ability resets its cooldown once its effect starts or has elapsed (75 second cooldown, reset upon death).
augments.description_zh_TW: 施放大絕後重置其冷卻時間(冷卻時間@Cooldown@秒，或在死亡時重置)。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在施放终极技能后刷新你的终极技能(@Cooldown@秒冷却时间或阵亡时重置)。
augments.description_ja: アルティメットスキルが発動後にリフレッシュされる(クールダウン@Cooldown@秒、または倒されるとリセット)。
augments.description_ko: 궁극기를 사용한 다음 초기화합니다. (재사용 대기시간 @Cooldown@초 또는 사망 시 초기화)

augments.name: Firebrand
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks apply a Burn for 5 seconds that deals bonus magic damage equal to「 0.4% of the target's maximum health per second. 」「 2% of the target's maximum health over the duration. 」This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application.
augments.description_zh_TW: 普攻{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}造成燃燒效果，並持續造成傷害，可無限累加。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的攻击会施加一个可无限叠加的灼烧{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}，持续造成伤害。
augments.description_ja: 通常攻撃が無限にスタック可能な炎上{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}を付与し、継続ダメージを与える。
augments.description_ko: 기본 공격 시 무한히 중첩되는 화상({{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}) 효과를 적용해 지속적으로 피해를 입힙니다.

augments.name: Ultimate Unstoppable

names.ja: 破竹のアルティメット

augments.name_ja: 破竹のアルティメット
augments.wikiDescription: Casting your ultimate ability grants you crowd control immunity for 3 seconds (8 second cooldown).
augments.description_zh_TW: 使用大絕後會免疫控場效果@UnstoppableDuration@秒(冷卻時間@Cooldown@秒)。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在你使用你的终极技能后，你获得持续@UnstoppableDuration@秒的控制免疫。 (@Cooldown@秒冷却时间)。
augments.description_ja: アルティメットスキルを使用すると、@UnstoppableDuration@秒間、行動妨害効果を受けなくなる(クールダウン@Cooldown@秒)。
augments.description_ko: 궁극기 사용 시 @UnstoppableDuration@초 동안 군중 제어 효과에 면역이 됩니다. (재사용 대기시간 @Cooldown@초)

augments.name: Dive Bomber
augments.wikiDescription: Upon death, you explode to deal true damage equal to 20% of the target's maximum health to enemies within 500 units.
augments.description_zh_TW: 死亡時爆炸，造成大量真實傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在你阵亡时爆炸，造成巨量真实伤害。
augments.description_ja: 倒された際に爆発し、大量の確定ダメージを与える。
augments.description_ko: 사망 시 폭발하여 막대한 고정 피해를 입힙니다.

augments.name: Mountain Soul
augments.wikiDescription: Grants the Mountain Dragon Soul, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得裂地龍魂，脫離戰鬥一段時間後可獲得一道護盾。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你获得山脉龙魂，在脱离战斗之后获得一个持续一小段时间的护盾。
augments.description_ja: 「マウンテンソウル」を獲得し、少しの間、非戦闘状態が続くとシールドを獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 전투에서 벗어나면 잠시 동안 보호막을 획득하는 대지의 영혼을 얻습니다.

augments.name: Fey Magic
augments.wikiDescription: Damaging enemies with your ultimate ability polymorphs them into harmless critters for 2 seconds, during which their base movement speed is reduced by 60, and disarms them for the same duration (15 second cooldown per target).
augments.description_zh_TW: 使用大絕造成傷害會變形敵軍幾秒。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的终极技能的伤害会对敌人造成持续若干秒的变形效果。
augments.description_ja: アルティメットスキルでダメージを与えると、敵に数秒間のポリモーフ効果を付与する。
augments.description_ko: 궁극기로 적에게 피해를 입히면 몇 초 동안 변이시킵니다.

augments.name: Nature is Healing

names.ja: 大自然が回復している

augments.name_ja: 大自然が回復している
augments.wikiDescription: Upon entering a patch of brush, you are healed for「 40 – 300 (based on level) (+ 15% of your missing health) 」「 6.67 – 50 (based on level) (+ 2.5% of your missing health) every 0.25 seconds 」over 1.5 seconds (20 second cooldown per brush patch).
augments.description_zh_TW: 進入草叢時，治療大量生命。
augments.description_zh_CN: 进入草丛时回复大量生命值。
augments.description_ja: 茂みに入ると体力を大幅に自動回復する。
augments.description_ko: 수풀에 들어가면 대량의 체력을 회복합니다.

augments.name: Poltergeist
augments.wikiDescription: Replace a summoner spell with Poltergeist. Poltergeist: Casts both Barrier and Ghost on yourself, both lasting 5 seconds and with the former granting a shield for 110 – 440 (based on level) and the latter granting 30% bonus movement speed.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得召喚師技能「搗蛋鬼」。 「搗蛋鬼」可施放「光盾」和「鬼步」。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得【吵闹鬼】作为一个召唤师技能。 吵闹鬼会同时施放召唤师技能【屏障】和【幽灵疾步】。
augments.description_ja: サモナースペルとして「ポルターガイスト」を獲得する。 「ポルターガイスト」は「バリア」と「ゴースト」の両方を発動する。
augments.description_ko: 폴터가이스트 소환사 주문을 얻습니다. 폴터가이스트는 방어막과 유체화를 동시에 사용합니다.

augments.name: Spiritual Purification
augments.wikiDescription: Scoring a champion takedown causes the area around the slain champion to explode in a 500 unit radius, dealing adaptive damage to enemies within equal to 15% of their current health and leaving behind a zone for 1.5 seconds that slows enemies within by 60%.
augments.description_zh_TW: 參與擊殺時會產生爆炸，使鄰近敵軍緩速@SlowAmount*100@%，並根據其當前生命造成傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 参与击杀时，产生一次爆炸，对附近其它敌人们造成@SlowAmount*100@%减速，并且造成基于他们当前生命值的伤害。
augments.description_ja: キルまたはアシスト獲得時、爆発を起こして周囲の他の敵に@SlowAmount*100@%のスロウ効果を与え、現在体力に応じたダメージを与える。
augments.description_ko: 처치 관여 시 폭발을 일으켜 주변 다른 적을 @SlowAmount*100@% 둔화시키고 적 현재 체력에 비례하는 피해를 입힙니다.

augments.name: Impassable
augments.wikiDescription: Gain the Aftershock and Glacial Augment keystone runes. Aftershock Cooldown reduced to 15 seconds from 20. Glacial Augment Cooldown reduced to 15 seconds from 25.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得裂地衝擊與冰川增幅關鍵符文。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得余震和冰川增幅基石符文。
augments.description_ja: キーストーンルーンの「アフターショック」と「グレイシャルオーグメント」を獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 여진과 빙결 강화 핵심 룬을 얻습니다.

augments.name: Nightstalking
augments.wikiDescription: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them renders you invisible for 1.5 seconds, during which you also gain 40% bonus movement speed. Attacking or casting abilites ends the stealth immediately.
augments.description_zh_TW: 對敵方英雄造成傷害後，在@TakedownWindow@秒內參與擊殺他們，會增加跑速，並讓你進入隱形狀態。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在对敌人造成伤害的@TakedownWindow@秒内参与击杀该敌人会为你提供移动速度并使你进入隐身状态。
augments.description_ja: 敵チャンピオンにダメージを与えてから@TakedownWindow@秒以内にその対象からキルまたはアシストを獲得すると、移動速度が増加し、自身をインビジブル状態にする。
augments.description_ko: 자신이 피해를 입힌 챔피언이 @TakedownWindow@초 안에 죽으면 이동 속도가 증가하고 투명 상태가 됩니다.

augments.name: Blade Waltz
augments.wikiDescription: Replace a summoner spell with Blade Waltz. Blade Waltz: Blink to the target enemy champion. You then blink to the nearest other enemy champion every 0.25 seconds over the next 1.75 seconds, blinking up to 7 additional times. The last blink targets the primary target. Each time you blink to an enemy, deal 30 – 150 (based on level) (+ 10% bonus AD) (+ 6% AP) physical damage to them and apply on-hit effects at 50% effectiveness, up to a total of 180 – 900 (based on level) (+ 60% bonus AD) (+ 36% AP) (45 second cooldown). While Blade Waltz is active, you are untargetable and unable to act. This effect will end prematurely if there are no longer any nearby valid targets to blink to. An enemy can be blinked to more than once if there are no other valid targets in range.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得召喚師技能華爾茲劍舞。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得利刃华尔兹作为一个召唤师技能。
augments.description_ja: サモナースペルとしてブレードワルツを獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 검무 소환사 주문을 얻습니다.

augments.name: Juiced
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks on-hit against enemy champions consume 2.5% of your maximum mana to deal bonus magic damage equal to 4.5% of your maximum mana. This damage can critically strike for (100% + 30%) bonus damage.
augments.description_zh_TW: %i:OnHit%命中會消耗@Calc_Mana_Cost@魔力造成@Calc_Damage@魔法傷害，此傷害可暴擊。
augments.description_zh_CN: %i:OnHit%攻击特效消耗@Calc_Mana_Cost@法力值以造成@Calc_Damage@魔法伤害，这个伤害可以暴击。
augments.description_ja: %i:OnHit%通常攻撃時、@Calc_Mana_Cost@マナを消費して魔法ダメージを@Calc_Damage@与える。このダメージはクリティカル判定を持つ。
augments.description_ko: %i:OnHit% 적중 시 마나를 @Calc_Mana_Cost@ 소모해 @Calc_Damage@의 마법 피해를 입힙니다. 이 피해량에는 치명타가 적용될 수 있습니다.

augments.name: Tripleshot
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that is unit-targeted and fires a missile, empowering the ability to fire its missiles at two additional enemies near the primary target. Subsequent hits from the same cast against the same enemy deal 30% damage.
augments.description_zh_TW: 你的{{SpellName}}會額外鎖定你前方的2名敵軍。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的【{{SpellName}}】技能会瞄准你前方2个额外的敌人。
augments.description_ja: {{SpellName}}が自身の前方にいる敵を追加で2体対象にする。
augments.description_ko: {{SpellName}} 스킬이 전방에 있는 적 2명을 추가로 대상 지정합니다.

augments.name: Protein Shake
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 25% (+ 35% per 100 bonus armor) (+ 35% per 100 bonus magic resistance) heal and shield power.
augments.description_zh_TW: 根據額外物防和魔防，增加%i:scaleHealShield%@BonusHSPower@%治療量和護盾量。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得%i:scaleHealShield%@BonusHSPower@%治疗和护盾强度，基于额外护甲和魔抗。
augments.description_ja: 増加物理防御および増加魔法防御に応じて、体力回復およびシールド効果が%i:scaleHealShield%@BonusHSPower@%増加する。
augments.description_ko: 추가 방어력 및 마법 저항력에 비례하여 %i:scaleHealShield%@BonusHSPower@%의 체력 회복 및 보호막 효과를 얻습니다.

augments.name: Hellbent
augments.wikiDescription: Generate a stack of Revivemaxxing for each enemy champion you hit with basic attacks or abilities, lasting for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits, and stacking up to 10 times. At maximum stacks, you become Hellbent. Hellbent: Upon taking lethal damage, you enter resurrection for 4 seconds, during which you are invulnerable, untargetable, and unable to act. Afterwards, you revive with 35% – 75% (based on level) of your maximum health (90 second cooldown). Additionally, you become empowered for the next 15 seconds, granting you 15 – 120 (based on level) bonus Attack Damage or 25 – 200 (based on level) Ability Power (Adaptive), 20% – 40% (based on level) bonus movement speed while facing toward nearby enemy champions, and 15% – 30% (based on level) omnivamp for the duration.
augments.description_zh_TW: 透過普攻或技能傷害敵方英雄會賦予層數。滿層後，死亡時會復活並獲得強化。
augments.description_zh_CN: 用攻击或技能伤害敌方英雄时会提供层数。在满层时，你在阵亡时会进行强化复活。
augments.description_ja: 敵チャンピオンに通常攻撃またはスキルでダメージを与えると、スタックを獲得する。最大スタック時に倒されると強化されて復活する。
augments.description_ko: 적 챔피언에게 기본 공격 또는 스킬로 피해를 입히면 중첩을 얻습니다. 중첩이 최대치에 도달하면 사망 시 강화된 상태로 부활합니다.

augments.name: Flashbang
augments.wikiDescription: Using Flash creates an explosion around the blink location that deals 70 – 240 (based on level) (+ 70% AD) (+ 60% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 35% for 1.25 seconds. Additionally, the cooldown of your Flash resets upon your death. If Flash is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Flash.
augments.description_zh_TW: 閃現會觸發爆炸，造成傷害和緩速效果(死亡時重置)。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的【闪现】会引发一次爆炸，造成伤害和减速（阵亡时重置）。
augments.description_ja: 自分が「フラッシュ」を使用すると爆発が発生し、ダメージとスロウ効果を与える (倒されるとリセットされる)。
augments.description_ko: 점멸 시 폭발을 일으켜 피해를 입히고 둔화시킵니다. (사망 시 초기화)

augments.name: Empyrean Promise
augments.wikiDescription: Replace a summoner spell with Empyrean Promise's Vigilance active. Additionally, gain 15% heal and shield power. Active - Vigilance: After a 0.25-second delay, dash to the current location of the target allied champion and gain a 100 – 250 (based on level) (+ 100% AP) (+ 10% bonus health) shield for 3 seconds. Upon arrival, grant the ally the same shield (20 second cooldown; 2000 range).
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加%i:scaleHealShield% @HSAmp*100@%治療量和護盾量。獲得幻焰之誓召喚師技能。 全神貫注 傳送到友軍身旁，抵達時獲得@ShieldAmount@護盾，持續@ShieldDuration@秒。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得%i:scaleHealShield%@HSAmp*100@%治疗和护盾强度。获得至高天诺言作为一个召唤师技能。 警惕 传送至你的友军并在着陆时提供持续@ShieldDuration@秒的@ShieldAmount@护盾值。
augments.description_ja: 体力回復およびシールド効果が%i:scaleHealShield% @HSAmp*100@%増加する。サモナースペルとして荘厳の天球の約束を獲得する。 警戒 味方のところまでテレポートし、到着後@ShieldDuration@秒間、耐久値@ShieldAmount@のシールドを付与する。
augments.description_ko: 체력 회복 및 보호막 효과%i:scaleHealShield%가 @HSAmp*100@% 증가합니다. 창공의 서약 소환사 주문을 얻습니다. 경계 아군에게 순간이동하고, 착지 후 @ShieldDuration@초 동안 @ShieldAmount@의 피해를 흡수하는 보호막을 부여합니다.

augments.name: Kill Secured
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 60% bonus movement speed towards enemy champions below 40% of their maximum health.
augments.description_zh_TW: 跑向低生命敵軍時，增加跑速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在朝着低生命值的敌人时，获得额外移动速度。
augments.description_ja: 体力が低い敵の方向へ移動する際、移動速度が増加する。
augments.description_ko: 체력이 낮은 적에게 접근 시 이동 속도가 증가합니다.

augments.name: Porcupine
augments.wikiDescription: Taking damage from champions builds up a burst of needles that fly out of you, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.

augments.name: Stuck In Here With Me
