names.ja: 一緒に閉じ込められた

augments.name_ja: 一緒に閉じ込められた
augments.wikiDescription: Casting your ultimate ability grants you an aura for 2 seconds, growing in size over the duration to up to 500 units. After the duration, you taunt all enemies within the aura for 2 seconds and gain 50% damage reduction for the same duration (30 second cooldown). Additionally, gain 30 ultimate haste. Aura is activated once the ultimate's effect starts or has elapsed. On Katarina, this augment will activate at the start of Death Lotus' channel.
augments.description_zh_TW: 施放大絕後，嘲諷鄰近敵軍並賦予自身傷害減免。 獲得@UltimateHaste@大絕技能加速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 使用你的终极技能时会嘲讽附近的敌人们并提供给你伤害减免。 获得@UltimateHaste@终极技能急速。
augments.description_ja: アルティメットスキル使用後、周囲の敵をタウントし、ダメージ軽減率が増加する。 アルティメットスキルヘイストが@UltimateHaste@増加する。
augments.description_ko: 궁극기를 사용하면 주변 적을 도발하고 피해량 감소를 얻습니다. 궁극기 스킬 가속이 @UltimateHaste@ 증가합니다.

augments.name: Echo Cast
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to summon a clone of your champion that is untargetable and moves up to 500 units towards your cursor. The clone then casts the ability it was summoned from after a 0.25-second delay, mimicking the active effects of the casted spell and disappearing after it finishes casting. Clone movement speed is 1000. Clone has a maximum lifetime of 7 seconds.
augments.description_zh_TW: 施放{{SpellName}}時會朝滑鼠位置製造一個分身，並重施技能。
augments.description_zh_CN: 施放你的【{{SpellName}}】技能时会朝你的鼠标位置派出一个复制体并再次施放该技能。
augments.description_ja: {{SpellName}}使用時、マウスカーソルの位置にクローンを送り出し、再発動する。
augments.description_ko: {{SpellName}} 스킬을 사용하면 마우스 커서 위치로 분신을 보내고 스킬을 재사용합니다.

augments.name: Spell Split
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a missile, empowering the ability's missile to split in two over 0.25 seconds upon hitting an enemy, at maximum range, or when recast. Each of the split missiles fire perpendicularly in opposite directions and apply the same effects to enemies they hit. Subsequent missile hits from the same cast against the same enemy deal 30% damage. Recast can be used after 0.15 seconds of the initial cast.
augments.description_zh_TW: 你的{{SpellName}}飛彈在命中、達到最遠距離或重施技能時會分裂成兩發。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在命中时、最大距离时或再次施放时，你的【{{SpellName}}】技能的飞弹会分裂为两部分。
augments.description_ja: 自身の{{SpellName}}のミサイルが、命中時、最大射程到達時、再発動時に2つに分裂する。
augments.description_ko: {{SpellName}} 투사체가 적중하거나 최대 사거리에 도달하거나 재사용 시 두 개로 나뉩니다.

augments.name: Shark Tempest
augments.wikiDescription: Your Mark is empowered to circle sharks around it in a 300 radius, dealing 50 – 100 (based on level) magic damage to enemies it passes through as it travels and slowing targets hit by 30% for 1 second. If the missile hits an enemy champion, the sharks circle around their location in a 425 radius instead for 3 seconds, dealing「 25 – 75 (based on level) (+ 20% bonus AD) (+ 12% AP) magic damage every second 」「 75 – 225 (based on level) (+ 60% bonus AD) (+ 36% AP) total magic damage over the duration 」to enemies within the area and slowing them by 30% for 3 seconds. If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark. The damage dealt by this augment counts as area damage, thus it is able to trigger spell effects.
augments.description_zh_TW: 鯊魚會圍繞你的雪球盤旋，緩速並傷害鄰近敵軍。當你的雪球命中英雄時，對方會被困在鯊魚風暴中！
augments.description_zh_CN: 鲨鱼们环绕着你的【雪球】，对附近的敌人们造成伤害和减速。当你的【雪球】命中一个英雄时，其会陷入一阵鲨鱼风暴之中！
augments.description_ja: サメが雪玉の周囲を旋回し、周囲の敵にスロウ効果とダメージを与える。雪玉がチャンピオンに命中すると、そのチャンピオンはサメの嵐に閉じ込められる！
augments.description_ko: 상어가 눈덩이 주위를 돌며 주변 적을 둔화시키고 피해를 입힙니다. 눈덩이가 챔피언에게 적중하면 해당 챔피언이 상어 폭풍에 갇힙니다!

augments.name: Flash 2
augments.wikiDescription: Replace a summoner spell with Flash. Additionally, gain 70 summoner spell haste.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得第二次閃現召喚師技能和@SummonerHaste@召喚師技能加速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得第二个【闪现】召唤师技能和@SummonerHaste@召唤师技能急速。
augments.description_ja: 2つ目の「フラッシュ」サモナースペルとサモナーヘイスト@SummonerHaste@を獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 두 번째 점멸 소환사 주문을 얻고 소환사 주문 가속이 @SummonerHaste@ 증가합니다.

augments.name: Triggered Inferno

names.ja: 巻き起こるインフェルノ

augments.name_ja: 巻き起こるインフェルノ
augments.wikiDescription: Your damaging basic attacks and abilities against at least one enemy champion unique from the previous damaging hit made against champions generate a stack of Style for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent unique or non-unique hits and stacking up to 7 times. For each stack, gain 4.25% / 4.5% / 4.75% / 5% (based on level) bonus movement speed, up to a maximum of 29.75% / 31.5% / 33.25% / 35% (based on level). Upon reaching maximum Style stacks, you unleash a torrent of shots for 2.277 seconds, during which you rapidly shoot at nearby enemies over 2.013 seconds at sporadic times in 0.2-second intervals each (up to 10 times per enemy), dealing 20 – 40 (based on level) (+ 40% AD) (+ 25% AP) physical damage with each shot, reduced by 75% against minions. Enemies below 30% of their maximum health are critically struck for「 double damage 」「 40 – 80 (based on level) (+ 80% AD) (+ 50% AP) physical damage 」(15 second cooldown). This effect ends prematurely if you become affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control. Style stacks are represented by grades (→→→→→→). The stacks are consumed at the end of the shooting effect. Shot damage applies life steal. The Style stack count and corresponding symbol letter (see above) is indicated underneath your champion's model.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得敢死風采。煞氣等級達到S時，自動使用「地獄火狂襲」。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得悍勇本色。在你达到S评价等级时，自动使用炼狱扳机。
augments.description_ja: デアデビルインパルスを獲得する。Sスタイルに到達すると、自動的にインフェルノトリガーを使用する。
augments.description_ko: 무모한 충동을 얻습니다. 스타일이 S등급에 도달하면 지옥불 난사를 자동 사용합니다.

augments.name: Hide on Bush
augments.wikiDescription: While in brush, you deal 20% increased damage. This effect lingers for 2 seconds after leaving brush.
augments.description_zh_TW: 進入草叢後，可造成額外@DamageAmplification*100@%傷害，持續@BuffDuration@秒。待在草叢中可重置效果。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在进入草丛后，多造成@DamageAmplification*100@%伤害，持续@BuffDuration@秒。留在草丛中会刷新这个效果。
augments.description_ja: 茂みに入ると@BuffDuration@秒間、与えるダメージが@DamageAmplification*100@%増加する。茂みに留まっていると効果がリフレッシュされる。
augments.description_ko: 수풀에 들어간 후 @BuffDuration@초 동안 피해량이 @DamageAmplification*100@% 증가합니다. 수풀에 머무르면 효과가 초기화됩니다.

augments.name: Can't Touch This
augments.wikiDescription: Casting your ultimate grants you invulnerability for 2 seconds (8 second cooldown).
augments.description_zh_TW: 施放大絕時，進入無敵狀態，持續一小段時間。
augments.description_zh_CN: 施放你的终极技能会使你进入短时间的免疫伤害状态。
augments.description_ja: アルティメットスキルを発動すると、少しの間無敵状態になる。
augments.description_ko: 궁극기를 사용하면 잠시 동안 무적 상태가 됩니다.

augments.name: Pandora's Box
augments.wikiDescription: Gain one random Prismatic-tier augment. Additionally, your current augments transform into an equal number of completely random Prismatic-tier ones.
augments.description_zh_TW: 將所有的增幅裝置物轉化為隨機稜鏡%i:Augment%增幅裝置。
augments.description_zh_CN: 将你的所有强化符文变为随机的棱彩阶%i:Augment%强化符文。
augments.description_ja: 自分のすべてのオーグメントがランダムなプリズム%i:Augment%オーグメントに変質する。
augments.description_ko: 모든 증강을 무작위 프리즘%i:Augment% 증강으로 전환합니다.

augments.name: Rite of Ascension
augments.wikiDescription: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them causes them to leave behind their Essence for 8 seconds. You can basic attack the Essence within 400 units to consume it: causing you to blink to its location after winding up for 1.25 seconds, during which you are untargetable (except to turrets), displacement immune, and unable to act. Upon consumption of the Essence, you gain 100% bonus movement speed decaying over 2 seconds, heal yourself for 75 – 300 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 25% AP), and reset the cooldowns of your basic abilities. The heal is increased by 0% – 100% (based on your missing health), for a maximum heal of 150 – 600 (based on level) (+ 100% bonus AD) (+ 50% AP).
augments.description_zh_TW: 參與擊殺時，敵方英雄會留下精華。攻擊精華會獲得跑速，並重置基礎技能冷卻時間。
augments.description_zh_CN: 参与击杀敌方英雄后会留下其精华。攻击该精华会提供移动速度并重置基础技能冷却时间。
augments.description_ja: キルまたはアシストを奪うと、敵チャンピオンが「エッセンス」を残す。「エッセンス」に通常攻撃を行うと移動速度が増加し、通常スキルのクールダウンがリセットされる。
augments.description_ko: 처치 관여 시 적 챔피언이 정수를 남깁니다. 정수를 공격하면 이동 속도가 증가하고 기본 스킬 재사용 대기시간이 초기화됩니다.

augments.name: Snowday
augments.wikiDescription: Your Mark deals bonus magic damage equal to 100% of its damage and has its cooldown reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste. If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

augments.name: Shrink Ray
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks on-hit reduce the target's damage dealt by 15% for 3 seconds, refreshing with each hit. Their size is also reduced significantly for the duration.
augments.description_zh_TW: 你的普攻{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}會使目標的傷害和體型降低@DamageReduction*100@%。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的攻击会将目标的伤害与体型削减@DamageReduction*100@%{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}。
augments.description_ja: 通常攻撃が対象のダメージとサイズを@DamageReduction*100@%低下させる({{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }})。
augments.description_ko: 기본 공격 시 대상의 입히는 피해량과 크기를 @DamageReduction*100@% 감소시킵니다. ({{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }})

augments.name: Prom Queen
augments.wikiDescription: Automatically cast a modified version of Rakan's The Quickness, empowering you to break into a captivating sprint for 6 seconds. While empowered, you gain ghosting and 50% bonus movement speed, and enemies you collide with are knocked down and become charmed for 1.5 seconds (35 second cooldown). A sparkly tiara will descend upon you 2.5 seconds before the effect activates.
augments.description_zh_TW: 每隔@BaseCD@秒自動施放，以閃亮寶冠為自己加冕。戴上寶冠時，獲得銳空的大絕，可魅惑觸碰到的敵軍。
augments.description_zh_CN: 每@BaseCD@秒，自动施放一道闪亮宝冠降临在你头上。当它着陆时，获得洛的终极技能，魅惑你碰到的敌人们。
augments.description_ja: @BaseCD@秒ごとに自動発動で光り輝くティアラが頭上に降りてくる。その着地時にラカンのアルティメットを獲得し、触れた敵にチャーム効果を与える。
augments.description_ko: @BaseCD@초마다 반짝이는 티아라를 자동 사용해 자신에게 내려오게 합니다. 티아라를 쓰면 라칸의 궁극기를 얻어 닿는 적을 매혹합니다.

augments.name: Our Healing
augments.wikiDescription: Whenever a nearby unit is healed (excluding yourself), you heal yourself equal to 15% of the amount they healed, doubled to 30% from the heals of enemies.
augments.description_zh_TW: 當其他人在你周圍接受治療時，你也會獲得其中@AllyHealingRatio*100@%的治療效果。來自敵軍的治療效果加倍。
augments.description_zh_CN: 每当你周围的某人进行治疗时，你获得相当于其@AllyHealingRatio*100@%治疗效果的治疗效果。从敌方治疗中获得双倍。
augments.description_ja: 周囲で誰かが体力を回復すると、自身もその@AllyHealingRatio*100@%にあたる体力を回復する。敵が回復した場合は効果が2倍になる。
augments.description_ko: 주변의 누군가가 체력을 회복할 때마다 그 회복량의 @AllyHealingRatio*100@%만큼 자신의 체력을 회복합니다. 적의 체력 회복 효과는 두 배로 적용됩니다.

augments.name: Mighty Shield
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 40 – 100 (based on level) adaptive force for 3 seconds upon gaining a shield (5 second cooldown).
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得護盾時，增加%i:miniAdaptiveForce%@AdaptiveAmp@適性之力，持續@ShieldDuration@秒(冷卻時間@Cooldown@秒)。
augments.description_zh_CN: 当你获得护盾时，获得%i:miniAdaptiveForce%@AdaptiveAmp@适应之力，持续@ShieldDuration@秒。(@Cooldown@秒冷却时间)
augments.description_ja: シールド獲得時に@ShieldDuration@秒間、%i:miniAdaptiveForce%@AdaptiveAmp@アダプティブフォースを獲得する(クールダウン@Cooldown@秒)。
augments.description_ko: 보호막을 얻으면 @ShieldDuration@초 동안 @AdaptiveAmp@의 적응형 능력치%i:miniAdaptiveForce%를 얻습니다. (재사용 대기시간 @Cooldown@초)

augments.name: Terror
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to fear all enemies within 450 units of you for 1.75 seconds (30 second cooldown).
augments.description_zh_TW: 施放{{SpellName}}時，使周圍敵軍陷入恐懼。
augments.description_zh_CN: 每当你施放【{{SpellName}}】技能时，恐惧你周围的敌人们.
augments.description_ja: {{SpellName}}を使用するたびに周囲の敵にフィアー効果を与える。
augments.description_ko: {{SpellName}} 스킬을 사용할 때마다 주변 적을 공포에 빠뜨립니다.

augments.name: Pin Cushion
augments.wikiDescription: Attacks during your chosen ability apply Marks that explode at the end of its duration, dealing damage and granting Move Speed.

augments.name: Pinball
augments.wikiDescription: Your Mark is empowered to instead throw a pinball, which deals 100 – 500 (based on level) bonus true damage and ricochets off of terrain that it collides with. Each time the pinball ricochets, its remaining travel distance is reset, it increases in radius by 25%, deals 20% increased damage, and reduces Mark's remaining cooldown by 30%. The pinball can ricochet up to 4 times, for a maximum radius increase of 100% and a damage increase of 80%. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 50 ability haste. If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.
augments.description_zh_TW: 你的雪球獲得技能加速，且會造成額外真實傷害。 雪球碰到牆體反彈時，體積和傷害會增加，並縮短冷卻時間。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的雪球获得技能急速并且造成额外的真实伤害。 当雪球从墙体上反弹时，它的体型和伤害获得提升，并缩短它的冷却时间。
augments.description_ja: 雪玉のスキルヘイストが増加し、確定ダメージを追加で与える。 雪玉は壁に跳ね返るとサイズとダメージが増加し、クールダウンが短縮される。
augments.description_ko: 눈덩이의 스킬 가속이 증가하고 추가 고정 피해를 입힙니다. 눈덩이가 벽에 튕기면 크기와 피해량이 증가하고 재사용 대기시간이 감소합니다.

augments.name: Titan's Resolve
augments.wikiDescription: You generate a stack of Juggernauting for each instance of damage you deal or take (excluding damage over time), lasting for 6 seconds and refreshing on subsequent damage dealt or taken. For every 10 stacks of Juggernauting, you gain 15 – 45 (based on level) bonus Attack Damage or 25 – 75 (based on level) Ability Power (Adaptive), 5 – 10 (based on level) bonus armor and bonus magic resistance, 10% increased size, and 8% tenacity. Stacks expire one by one when the duration ends, with the decay rate being faster the more stacks you have.
augments.description_zh_TW: 受到或造成傷害時獲得層數。每累積@Stacks_Max@層，便獲得適性之力、物防、魔防、體型和韌性。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在承受或造成伤害时获得层数。每@Stacks_Max@层，获得适应之力、护甲、魔法抗性、体型和韧性。
augments.description_ja: ダメージを受けるかダメージを与えるとスタックを獲得する。@Stacks_Max@スタックごとに、アダプティブフォース、物理防御、魔法防御、サイズ、行動妨害耐性が増加する。
augments.description_ko: 피해를 받거나 입히면 중첩을 얻습니다. @Stacks_Max@중첩마다 적응형 능력치, 방어력, 마법 저항력, 크기, 강인함을 얻습니다.

augments.name: Multishot
augments.wikiDescription: Assigns quests that require you to hit enemy champions with a specific ability's missile a number of times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance). There are six quest tiers, and each completed tier rewards you with an additional missile fired on the ability's cast. The reward effect also modifies the ability to fire all of its missiles in a cone. Subsequent missile hits from the same cast against the same enemy deal 30% damage. Hit requirements as denoted below are rounded down to whole numbers, with a minimum value of 1.

augments.name: Snowblast
augments.wikiDescription: Empowers the Dash spell from Mark to deal 100% increased damage and upon arrival cause you to knock up the target for 0.5 seconds and knock back nearby enemies. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste. If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.
augments.description_zh_TW: 重施雪球會造成更高的傷害，擊飛目標，並擊退鄰近敵軍。
augments.description_zh_CN: 再次施放雪球会造成提升伤害、击飞该目标、并击退附近的敌人们。
augments.description_ja: 雪玉を再発動するとダメージが増加し、対象をノックアップして、周囲の敵をノックバックする。
augments.description_ko: 눈덩이를 다시 사용하면 증가한 피해를 입히고 대상을 공중에 띄우며, 주변 적들을 뒤로 밀어냅니다.

augments.name: Spin Me Right Round
augments.wikiDescription: Replace a summoner spell with Akshan's Heroic Swing (10 second cooldown, starts post-effect). Heroic Swing - Active: You can activate Heroic Swing three times before the ability goes on cooldown, and you can use the third cast only after 0.5 seconds of the second cast. An attack or movement command may be inputted to use the second and third casts. First Cast: Fire a hook in the target direction that embeds in the first terrain hit for 2 seconds. Heroic Swing's second cast can be used while the hook is attached. If the hook fails to attach or you become immobilized, grounded, or polymorphed within the duration, Heroic Swing is cancelled and placed on full cooldown. Second Cast: Swing around the terrain in either a clockwise or counterclockwise direction based on the position of the cursor relative to your facing direction, stopping upon colliding with an enemy champion or terrain. While swinging, fire at the nearest visible enemy within your attack range (minimum 400 units) every 0.231 seconds to deal them 15 – 75 (based on level) (+ 15% AD) × (1 + 0.3 per 100% bonus attack speed) physical damage and apply on-hit effects for each shot, with on-hit damage reduced to 25% effectiveness. The dash will be interrupted if you are affected by any immobilizing or polymorphing crowd control during the dash. Third Cast: End the swing by jumping to the target location and fire one last shot at a nearby visible enemy.

augments.name: Surge Field
augments.wikiDescription: On Ultimate cast, spawn a Zone that grants Ability Haste and Movement Speed. While inside, it fires missiles that deal the required number of% of your damage.

augments.name: Holy Snowball
augments.wikiDescription: After using the Dash spell from Mark, you become invulnerable for 1.5 seconds upon arrival. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste. If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.
augments.description_zh_TW: 雪球增加@Haste@技能加速。 使用雪球衝刺時，短暫進入無敵狀態。 若你沒有雪球就會獲得一顆雪球。
augments.description_zh_CN: 雪球获得@Haste@技能急速。 你在用【雪球】冲刺后短暂免疫伤害。 如果你没有雪球，获得一个雪球。
augments.description_ja: 雪玉のスキルヘイストが@Haste@増加する。 雪玉を持ってダッシュすると、少しの間無敵になる。 まだ持っていない場合は雪玉を1個獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 눈덩이의 스킬 가속이 @Haste@만큼 증가합니다. 눈덩이로 돌진하면 잠시 무적 상태가 됩니다. 눈덩이를 보유하지 않은 경우 눈덩이를 얻습니다.

augments.name: Quickstep
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to cause you to dash up to 350 units towards your cursor.
augments.description_zh_TW: 使用{{SpellName}}時，朝著游標衝刺。
augments.description_zh_CN: 当你使用【{{SpellName}}】技能时，朝你的鼠标指针进行冲刺。
augments.description_ja: {{SpellName}}を使用すると、カーソルの方向にダッシュする。
augments.description_ko: {{SpellName}} 사용 시 커서 방향으로 돌진합니다.

augments.name: Glass Cannon
augments.wikiDescription: You gain a health threshold equal to 70% maximum health which cannot be modified nor exceeded by any means. In return, you deal bonus true damage equal to ( 25% / 15%) of all of the damage you deal pre-mitigation.
augments.description_zh_TW: 最大生命減少@HPReductionPerc*100@%。造成額外@TrueDamagePercSplit@真實傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 减少@HPReductionPerc*100@%最大生命值。造成@TrueDamagePercSplit@额外真实伤害。
augments.description_ja: 最大体力が@HPReductionPerc*100@%低下する。追加で@TrueDamagePercSplit@の確定ダメージを与える。
augments.description_ko: 최대 체력이 @HPReductionPerc*100@% 감소합니다. 피해량의 @TrueDamagePercSplit@만큼 추가 고정 피해를 입힙니다.

augments.name: Chain Reaction
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a knock back effect, empowering the ability to trigger a chain reaction effect when displaced champions hit other champions or terrain within 200 units. If a knocked back champion collides with another enemy champion during their displacement, the champions they collided with are dealt 100 – 400 (based on level) magic damage and knocked up for 0.5 seconds. If they collide with terrain during their displacement, they will rebound to take 150 – 800 (based on level) magic damage and become knocked up for 0.75 seconds and stunned for 0.5 seconds. The knock up duration is increased to up to 1.1 seconds based on how long the ability's cooldown is. If the upgraded ability is an ultimate, this effect deals 250% damage, increasing the champion collision damage to 250 – 1000 (based on level) and the terrain collision damage to 375 – 2000 (based on level).
augments.description_zh_TW: 如果目標被{{SpellName}}擊退時撞到另一位英雄，該英雄會被擊飛並受到傷害。如果撞擊地形，則延長擊飛時間並造成額外傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 如果一个被【{{SpellName}}】技能击退的目标命中了另一个英雄，则二者都会被击飞并受到伤害。在与地形产生碰撞时，该击飞时长会延长并且他们会受到额外伤害。
augments.description_ja: {{SpellName}}によってノックバックされた対象が別のチャンピオンに当たると、両方がノックアップ状態になり、ダメージを受ける。地形に衝突すると、ノックアップの効果時間が延長され、追加ダメージを受ける。
augments.description_ko: {{SpellName}} 스킬로 뒤로 밀어낸 대상이 다른 챔피언과 부딪히면 둘 다 공중에 뜨고 피해를 입습니다. 지형에 충돌하면 공중에 뜨는 시간이 길어지고 추가 피해를 입습니다.

augments.name: Dimension Shift

names.ja: ディメンションシフト

augments.name_ja: ディメンションシフト
augments.wikiDescription: Replace a summoner spell with When the Darkness Comes. When the Darkness Comes: Sends a bright, cosmic light arcing to the target location over 2 seconds. Upon impact, the light spreads out to cause all units within a 500 radius to be sent to the Dark Realm for 8 seconds. All units in the Dark Realm gain 45% bonus movement speed. If you are in the Dark Realm, you gain 35 – 150 (based on level) bonus attack damage, 35 – 150 (based on level) ability power, 300 – 1500 (based on level) bonus health, and 35% increased size. The Dark Realm is a battlefield that exists outside of the normal realm in an alternate dimension. It exists only for units hit by the cosmic light. The realm includes any terrain features that would exist in the map of the normal realm, including structures, walls, and brushes. Units between realms see each other as glowing stars, considering each other dead and negating any interactions between each other. Only units that were hit by the light will enter the realm; other units cannot follow them. Everything that occurs inside the Dark Realm is hidden to units outside of it, and vice versa. Structures exist in all realms at the same time, but champions in the Dark Realm can only deal 1 damage to them per damage instance. Turrets will behave normally as if all units were in the same realm. Pets still inside the Dark Realm are killed at its end.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得召喚師技能「黑暗時刻」。創造一個區域，將其中所有人傳送到另一個次元。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得当黑暗到来召唤师技能。生成一个地带来将它其中的所有人传送到另一个位面。
augments.description_ja: サモナースペルの「闇の訪れ」を獲得する。ゾーンを生成し、範囲内にいる全員を別次元に転送する。
augments.description_ko: 어둠이 드리우면 소환사 주문을 얻습니다. 내부의 모든 대상을 다른 차원으로 이동시키는 영역을 생성합니다.

augments.name: Poro Stampede
augments.wikiDescription: Poro-Snaxes will now randomly appear around you every 25 – 15 (based on level) seconds. You can pick up a Poro-Snax by moving over it, granting you a Poro-Snax charge. Poro-Snaxes will not spawn while you are at the maximum number of Poro-Snax charges (2). Feeding a Poro with a Poro-Snax generates a stack of Poro Love. At 5 stacks, you are granted the Poro Charge summoner spell and are prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with it. You are then assigned with quests that require you to reach a certain amount of Poro Love stacks. There are nine quest tiers, and each completed tier rewards you with an additional Poro wave for Poro Charge. Poro Charge: After a 1-second delay, you unleash a stampede of Poros, summoning a phalanx of 5 massive Poros that charge forward in the target direction. Enemies hit by the charge are dealt 100 – 200 (based on level) (+ 20 per Poro Love stack) physical damage, reduced to 15% against minions, and slowed by 85% for 2 seconds. Each Poro stops upon colliding with an enemy champion. Fire additional waves of Poros based on the number of Poro Love stacks you have. Each subsequent wave is fired 0.75 seconds after the previous one. Enemy champions take 50% damage from subsequent waves that hit them.
augments.description_zh_TW: 任務：收集普羅點心並餵食@QuestRequirement@普羅。 獎勵：召喚師技能「普羅衝鋒」——向敵方隊伍發射一波波超可愛又超危險的普羅。任務每升一級，就能發射更多次普羅。 「喔呵！你看看他們多可愛啊！」——普羅牧人
augments.description_zh_CN: 任务：收集【魄罗佳肴】并投喂@QuestRequirement@只魄罗 奖励：获得【魄罗冲锋】召唤师技能，可让魄罗们对敌方队伍发动几波攻势。每任务等级都会解锁额外的波次。 “噢吼！它们可真萌啊！”——魄罗驯养人
augments.description_ja: クエスト: 「ポロのおやつ」を集めて@QuestRequirement@体のポロにあげる。 報酬: サモナースペル「ポロチャージ」を獲得する。発動すると、敵チームに向かってポロの波を放つ。クエストレベルに応じて波の数が増加する。 「おや？なんて愛らしいんでしょう！」──ポロの世話係
augments.description_ko: 퀘스트: 포로 간식을 모아 포로 @QuestRequirement@마리에게 줘야 합니다. 보상: 적 팀에게 포로 무리를 날리는 포로 돌격 소환사 주문을 얻습니다. 퀘스트 레벨당 추가 무리를 얻습니다. "아! 어찌나 사랑스러운지!" - 포로치기

augments.wikiDescription: Your Enemy Missing pings will cause you to launch a missile at the pinged location, exploding upon arrival to deal 100 – 400 (based on level) (+ 10% of target's missing health) magic damage to enemies struck, and heal allied champions within for 50 – 200 (based on level) (+ 10% of target's missing health) . While equipped with this augment, the player can only use up to 3 Enemy Missing pings each within 6 seconds at most. This incurs a separate cooldown from the global one, sending an alert to the player that reads: You must wait before issuing more pings of that type. Otherwise, the global ping cooldown is incurred as normal. The heal is not affected by the -50% outgoing healing penalty from the ARAM global champion buff .

augments.name: Adamant
augments.wikiDescription: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants 10 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for 10 seconds, stacking up to 10 times for a total of 100 bonus resistances, and refreshing on subsequent triggers (5 second cooldown per cast instance).
augments.description_zh_TW: 每次硬控場或禁錮敵軍時，增加物防和魔防。
augments.description_zh_CN: 每当你定身或缚地一个敌人时，获得护甲和魔抗。
augments.description_ja: 敵に移動不能効果か釘付け効果を与えるたびに、物理防御と魔法防御が増加する。
augments.description_ko: 적을 이동 불가 상태로 만들거나 이동 스킬을 사용할 수 없게 할 때마다 방어력 및 마법 저항력을 얻습니다.

augments.name: Bounce of the Poro King

names.ja: ポロキングのバウンド

augments.name_ja: ポロキングのバウンド
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得普羅王跳跳！ 普羅王跳跳：化身普羅王，連續彈跳，對鄰近敵軍造成物理傷害並擊退他們。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得魄罗之王的弹跳！ 魄罗之王的弹跳：变身为【魄罗之王】并反复弹跳，造成物理伤害并击退 附近的敌人们。
augments.description_ja: ポロキングのバウンドを獲得する！ ポロキングのバウンド: ポロキングに変身して連続で跳ね周り、周囲の敵に物理ダメージを与えてノックバックする。
augments.description_ko: 포로 왕의 바운스를 획득합니다! 포로 왕의 바운스: 포로 왕으로 변신하여 주기적으로 튀어 오르며 주변 적에게 물리 피해를 입히고 뒤로 밀어냅니다.

augments.name: Buff Buddies
augments.description_zh_TW: 你獲得力量的餘燼和智慧的餘燼。 賦予自己技能加速和施法資源回復，並讓你的普攻對敵方英雄造成燃燒和緩速效果。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你获得余烬之冠和洞悉之冠。 为你自己提供技能急速和施法资源回复并使你的攻击对敌方英雄造成灼烧和减速。
augments.description_ja: 残火の赤紋章と洞察の青紋章を獲得する。 自身のスキルヘイストとリソース自動回復効果が増加し、通常攻撃が敵チャンピオンに炎上とスロウ効果を与える。
augments.description_ko: 잉걸불 문장과 통찰력의 문장을 획득합니다. 자신에게 스킬 가속 및 자원 재생을 부여하며, 기본 공격 시 적 챔피언에게 화상을 적용하고 둔화시킵니다.

augments.name: Cerberus
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得刀鋒之雹及強攻關鍵符文。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得丛刃和强攻基石符文。
augments.description_ja: 「ヘイルブレード」と「プレスアタック」のキーストーンルーンを獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 칼날비와 집중 공격 핵심 룬을 얻습니다.

augments.name: Cheating
augments.description_zh_TW: 點按回城即可返回基地、購買道具並獲得增幅裝置。
augments.description_zh_CN: 按下【回城】能够回到基地，购买装备并且获得强化符文。
augments.description_ja: リコールを押して本拠地に戻り、アイテムを購入してオーグメントを入手しよう。
augments.description_ko: 귀환 버튼을 눌러 기지로 복귀해, 아이템을 구매하고, 증강을 획득할 수 있습니다.

augments.name: Clown College
augments.wikiDescription: Gain Shaco's Backstab, Deceive and Hallucinate's explosion. Replace a summoner spell with Deceive. Passive - Backstab: Your basic attacks deal 20 – 35 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 35% AP) bonus physical damage on-hit when hitting an enemy from behind. Active - Deceive: Become invisible for up to 3 seconds and blink to the target location within 400 units after a 0.125-second delay. Your next basic attack while in stealth deals 100 (+ 150% bonus AD) (+ 55% AP) bonus physical damage, increased to「 155 (+ 232.5% bonus AD) (+ 85.25% AP) bonus physical damage 」「 155% damage 」if Backstab was applied (45 second cooldown). Passive - Hallucinate Death: Upon your death, release an explosion in a 350 radius of your death location, dealing magic damage equal to 25% of target's maximum health to enemies within the area. Additionally, you deploy a box at the location of your death that instantly fears nearby enemies for 1 second. This box does not attack but lasts for 3 seconds.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得召喚師技能「欺詐魔術」。 欺詐魔術：傳送並進入隱形狀態。隱形期間，下一次普攻造成額外物理傷害。 死亡時生成一個會爆炸的盒子，對鄰近敵軍造成大量魔法傷害及恐懼效果。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得召唤师技能欺诈魔术。 欺诈魔术：你传送并变为隐形。你在隐形状态下的下一次攻击造成额外物理伤害。在你阵亡时，生成一个爆炸盒子来对附近的敌人们造成大量魔法伤害和恐惧。
augments.description_ja: サモナースペル「幻惑」を獲得する。 「幻惑」: 瞬間移動してインビジブル状態になる。インビジブル状態中の次の通常攻撃が物理ダメージを追加で与える。 倒されると爆発する箱を出現させ、周囲の敵に大量の魔法ダメージとフィアー効果を与える。
augments.description_ko: 속임수 소환사 주문을 얻습니다. 속임수: 근처로 순간이동해 투명 상태가 됩니다. 투명 상태에서 다음 기본 공격 시 물리 피해를 추가로 입힙니다. 사망 시, 폭발하는 상자를 생성하여 엄청난 마법 피해를 입히고 주변 적을 공포에 빠뜨립니다.

augments.name: Crack Open That Egg
augments.description_zh_TW: 護盾會在失效時爆炸。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的护盾值将在到期时爆炸。
augments.description_ja: シールドが効果終了時に爆発する。
augments.description_ko: 보호막이 사라질 때 폭발합니다.

augments.name: Crit 'n Cast

names.ja: クリティカルキャスト

augments.name_ja: クリティカルキャスト
augments.wikiDescription: Gain ability haste equal to 40% of your critical strike chance.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得自身@CritToHasteConversion*100@%%i:scaleCrit%暴擊率的技能加速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得相当于你@CritToHasteConversion*100@%%i:scaleCrit%暴击几率的技能急速。
augments.description_ja: %i:scaleCrit%クリティカル率の@CritToHasteConversion*100@%にあたるスキルヘイストを獲得する。
augments.description_ko: %i:scaleCrit% 치명타 확률의 @CritToHasteConversion*100@%에 해당하는 스킬 가속을 얻습니다.

augments.name: Critical Healing
augments.wikiDescription: Your heals and shields now have a chance equal to your critical strike chance to increase in effectiveness by 40% (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.
augments.description_zh_TW: 你的治療與護盾可以暴擊，治療量或護盾量提升@CritHeal*100@%。增加%i:scaleCrit% @CritChance*100@%暴擊率。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的治疗和护盾可以暴击，造成@CritHeal*100@%额外数额的效果。获得%i:scaleCrit% @CritChance*100@%暴击几率。
augments.description_ja: 自身の体力回復とシールドに、効果量が@CritHeal*100@%上昇するクリティカル判定が付与される。クリティカル率が%i:scaleCrit% @CritChance*100@%増加する。
augments.description_ko: 체력 회복 및 보호막 효과에 치명타가 적용되어 @CritHeal*100@% 증폭될 수 있습니다. 치명타 확률%i:scaleCrit%이 @CritChance*100@% 증가합니다.

augments.name: Critical Missile

names.ja: クリティカルミサイル

augments.name_ja: クリティカルミサイル
augments.wikiDescription: Critical strikes against enemy champions launch 1 (+ 1 per 50% critical strike chance) missiles at the target that each deal 15 – 65 (based on level) magic damage. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance. Maximum total missile count is 3 at 100% critical strike chance. Critical strike chance in excess of 100% does not count. Critical strikes from Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability will launch missiles.
augments.description_zh_TW: 暴擊時，會發射飛彈，造成魔法傷害。 增加%i:scaleCrit% @CrtiChance*100@%暴擊率。
augments.description_zh_CN: 当你暴击时，发射飞弹造成魔法伤害。 获得%i:scaleCrit% @CrtiChance*100@%暴击几率。
augments.description_ja: クリティカル時にミサイルを発射し、魔法ダメージを与える。 %i:scaleCrit%クリティカル率が@CrtiChance*100@%増加する。
augments.description_ko: 치명타 적중 시 미사일을 발사해 마법 피해를 입힙니다. %i:scaleCrit% 치명타 확률이 @CrtiChance*100@% 증가합니다.

augments.name: Critical Rhythm
augments.wikiDescription: Your critical strikes grant you 6% bonus attack speed for 6 seconds, stacking up to 10 times for a total of 60%. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.
augments.description_zh_TW: 普攻暴擊時會累加攻速。 增加%i:scaleCrit% @CritChance*100@%暴擊率。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的普攻在暴击时获得可叠加的攻击速度。 获得%i:scaleCrit% @CritChance*100@%暴击几率。
augments.description_ja: 通常攻撃のクリティカル時に攻撃速度が増加するスタックを獲得する。 %i:scaleCrit%クリティカル率が@CritChance*100@%増加する。
augments.description_ko: 기본 공격 시 치명타가 발동하면 공격 속도 중첩을 획득합니다. %i:scaleCrit% 치명타 확률을 @CritChance*100@% 획득합니다.

augments.name: Demon's Dance
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得瞬疾步法及不死之握關鍵符文。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得迅捷步法和不灭之握基石符文。
augments.description_ja: キーストーンルーンの「フリートフットワーク」と「不死者の握撃」を獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 기민한 발놀림 및 착취의 손아귀 핵심 룬을 얻습니다.

augments.name: Devil on Your Shoulder
augments.wikiDescription: Forge a pact with Little Devil Teemo, who drains 0.5% of your current health every second, increased to 5% if there are enemy champions within 1000 units. In return, you deal 20% bonus true damage and your basic attacks and abilities summon a Life Remnant nearby for 5 seconds (0.75-second spawn cooldown). You can absorb a Life Remnant by moving over it, healing you for 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 25% AP) and granting you 15% bonus movement speed.
augments.description_zh_TW: 與小惡魔本魔締結契約。 他會持續汲取你的生命，但也會獎勵你，使你對英雄造成額外真實傷害，並生成生命殘渣給你。
augments.description_zh_CN: 与【大魔王】本尊签订一个契约。 他持续汲取你的生命力，但回报给你力量，让你对英雄造成额外真实伤害并且创造治疗残片供你获取。
augments.description_ja: かの恐ろしい「ちび悪魔」と契約を結ぶ。 時間とともに体力を吸い取られる代わりにチャンピオンに追加確定ダメージを与えるようになり、獲得すると体力が回復するかけらが発生する。
augments.description_ko: 작은 악마와 직접 계약을 맺습니다. 지속적으로 생명력을 흡수당하지만, 대가로 챔피언 대상 추가 고정 피해를 부여하고 획득할 수 있는 체력 회복 파편을 남깁니다.

augments.name: Double Tap
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks that critically strike apply on-hit effects an additional time. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.
augments.description_zh_TW: 暴擊額外施加一次%i:OnHit%命中效果。 增加%i:scaleCrit% @Calc_Crit_Chance@%暴擊率。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的暴击施加一次额外的%i:OnHit%攻击特效。 获得%i:scaleCrit% @Calc_Crit_Chance@暴击几率。
augments.description_ja: クリティカルヒット時、%i:OnHit%通常攻撃時効果を追加でもう一度適用する。 %i:scaleCrit%クリティカル率が@Calc_Crit_Chance@増加する。
augments.description_ko: 치명타 발동 시 %i:OnHit% 적중 시 효과를 한 번 더 적용합니다. %i:scaleCrit% 치명타 확률을 @Calc_Crit_Chance@ 획득합니다.

augments.name: Droppybara
augments.wikiDescription: Replace a summoner spell with Droppybara. Droppybara: Call upon a massive capybara to land down at the target location after 2.5 seconds, dealing true damage equal to the 30% of the target's maximum health to enemies within a 650 radius. Deals 70% damage to minions.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得召喚師技能「空降水豚」。 在短暫延遲後，召喚出水豚，造成@DamagetoChampions*100@%最大生命的真實傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得卡皮巴拉空投作为一个召唤师技能。 在一阵延迟后，召唤一个卡皮巴拉落下，造成@DamagetoChampions*100@%最大生命值的真实伤害。
augments.description_ja: サモナースペルとしてドロッピバラを獲得する。 発動から少し遅れて、カピバラが降り注ぎ、最大体力の@DamagetoChampions*100@%にあたる確定ダメージを与える。
augments.description_ko: 카피바라 폭격 소환사 주문을 얻습니다. 잠시 후 카피바라를 소환해 최대 체력의 @DamagetoChampions*100@%에 해당하는 고정 피해를 입힙니다.

augments.name: Executioner
augments.description_zh_TW: 對生命低於@HealthThreshold*100@%的敵軍造成@BonusDamage*100@%額外傷害。參與擊殺時，重置基礎技能。
augments.description_zh_CN: 对生命值低于@HealthThreshold*100@%的敌人们多造成@BonusDamage*100@%伤害。在参与击杀后重置你的基础技能。
augments.description_ja: 残り体力が@HealthThreshold*100@%未満の敵に対して与えるダメージが@BonusDamage*100@%増加する。キルまたはアシストを獲得すると、通常スキルがリセットされる。
augments.description_ko: 체력이 @HealthThreshold*100@% 아래로 떨어진 적에게 입히는 피해량이 @BonusDamage*100@% 증가합니다. 처치 관여 시 기본 스킬이 초기화됩니다.

augments.name: Feel the Burn
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得感受灼燒召喚師技能。 施放感受灼燒後，對所有鄰近敵方英雄施放點燃及虛弱。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得召唤师技能感受灼烧。 感受灼烧会对所有附近的敌人们施放引燃和虚弱。
augments.description_ja: サモナースペルの「熱気」を獲得する。 「熱気」を発動すると、周囲のすべての敵チャンピオンに「イグナイト」と「イグゾースト」を使用できる。
augments.description_ko: 저주의 화염 소환사 주문을 얻습니다. 저주의 화염을 사용하면 주변 모든 적 챔피언에게 점화와 탈진을 사용합니다.

augments.name: Final City Transit

names.ja: ファイナルシティ交通

augments.name_ja: ファイナルシティ交通
augments.wikiDescription: Upon death, you summon a train over 1 second that launches towards your killer at full speed, travelling in their direction at a global distance and dealing 150 – 750 (based on level) (+ 65% bonus AD) (+ 50% AP) (+ 15% maximum health) physical damage to enemies it passes through. The train is summoned a slight distance away from the front of your killer, based on their facing direction at the time of your death, and launches towards the position they were located at the time of your death.
augments.description_zh_TW: 死亡時，朝擊殺者發出一列火車，對命中的敵軍造成@Damage@物理傷害。列車沿途不停靠喔。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在你阵亡时，朝击杀你的敌人发动一辆列车，对它命中的每个敌人造成@Damage@物理伤害。这个列车不会停下。
augments.description_ja: デス時に、自身を倒した敵に向かって列車を発車させ、命中した敵に@Damage@の物理ダメージを与える。この列車は止まらない。
augments.description_ko: 사망하면 처치자를 향해 열차를 발사합니다. 열차에 적중당한 적은 @Damage@의 물리 피해를 입습니다. 열차는 멈추지 않습니다.

augments.name: Frost Wraith
augments.description_zh_TW: 每@Cooldown@秒自動施放，對鄰近敵軍造成定身效果，持續@RootDuration@秒。
augments.description_zh_CN: 每@Cooldown@秒，自动施放@RootDuration@秒禁锢给附近的敌人们。
augments.description_ja: @Cooldown@秒ごとに、周囲の敵に対して@RootDuration@秒間のスネア効果を自動で付与する。
augments.description_ko: 자동 사용 @Cooldown@초마다 주변 적을 @RootDuration@초 동안 속박합니다.

augments.name: Gash
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加@AS*100@%攻速。%i:OnHit%命中時造成真實傷害，傷害隨%i:scaleArmor%物防增加。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@AS*100@%攻击速度。造成真实伤害%i:OnHit% 攻击附伤，受益于你的%i:scaleArmor%护甲。
augments.description_ja: 攻撃速度が@AS*100@%増加する。%i:OnHit%通常攻撃時効果で%i:scaleArmor%物理防御に応じて増加する確定ダメージを与える。
augments.description_ko: 공격 속도가 @AS*100@% 증가합니다. 방어력%i:scaleArmor%에 비례해 적중 시%i:OnHit% 고정 피해를 입힙니다.

augments.name: Grandma's Chili Oil

names.ja: おばあちゃんのラー油

augments.name_ja: おばあちゃんのラー油
augments.description_zh_TW: 普攻和技能命中敵軍時，對其施加燃燒，在附近澆上一灘辣油。辣油能回復生命，並使敵軍燃燒。 施加越多燃燒，辣油效果越強。
augments.description_zh_CN: 普攻和技能在命中敌人时会对其施加一个灼烧，这个效果会在附近掉落一滩辣椒油。辣椒油会回复生命值并灼烧敌人们。 你施加的每个灼烧都会使辣椒油效果变得更强。
augments.description_ja: 通常攻撃およびスキルは敵に命中すると炎上させ、近くにラー油の沼を生成する。ラー油は体力を回復し、敵を炎上させる。 炎上を適用するごとに、ラー油の効果が高まっていく。
augments.description_ko: 적에게 기본 공격 및 스킬 적중 시 화상을 적용하고, 주변에 고추기름 웅덩이를 생성합니다. 고추기름은 체력을 회복시키고 적에게 화상을 적용합니다. 고추기름의 효과는 적용한 화상의 수에 비례해 강력해집니다.

augments.name: Guilty Pleasure
augments.wikiDescription: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion heals you for 30 – 250 (based on level) (+ 1.5% maximum health) (5 second cooldown per cast instance).
augments.description_zh_TW: 硬控場或禁錮敵方英雄時使你回復生命。
augments.description_zh_CN: 定身或缚地敌方英雄时对你进行治疗。
augments.description_ja: 敵チャンピオンに移動不能効果か釘付け効果を与えると、体力を回復する。
augments.description_ko: 적 챔피언을 이동 불가 상태로 만들거나 이동 스킬을 사용할 수 없게 하면 체력을 회복합니다.

augments.name: Hat on a Hat
augments.description_zh_TW: 頭部道具提供額外魔攻和魔防。
augments.description_zh_CN: 头戴式装备和帽子提供额外法术强度和魔法抗性。
augments.description_ja: 帽子系アイテムおよび帽子から追加の魔力と魔法防御を獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 머리에 착용하는 아이템과 모자가 추가로 주문력 및 마법 저항력을 제공합니다.

augments.name: Heads Up Cupcake!

names.ja: カップケーキに要注意！

augments.name_ja: カップケーキに要注意！
augments.description_zh_TW: 杯子蛋糕會不時飛過大橋。接住杯子蛋糕的玩家可獲得金錢，而被杯子蛋糕砸中的第一個英雄及其鄰近友軍會回復生命。根據治療量獲得金錢。
augments.description_zh_CN: 小蛋糕将间歇性地飞越整个大桥。小蛋糕会提供金币给接住它的人，并对第一个命中的英雄及其附近的友军回复生命值。获得基于该治疗数额的金币。
augments.description_ja: 一定時間ごとに、カップケーキが橋を横切って飛んでくる。カップケーキをキャッチしたチャンピオンはゴールドを獲得し、最初に当たったチャンピオンとその周囲の味方の体力を回復する。回復した体力量に応じてゴールドを獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 이따금 컵케이크가 다리 위로 날아갑니다. 컵케이크를 잡으면 골드를 획득하고 처음 컵케이크에 닿은 챔피언 및 주변 아군의 체력을 회복합니다. 체력 회복량에 따라 골드를 획득합니다.

augments.name: Holy Fire
augments.description_zh_TW: 治療或賦予護盾時，可對鄰近敵軍附加可無限累加的燃燒效果，在數秒內造成部分最大生命的魔法傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的治疗或护盾会对一个附近的敌人施加一层无限叠加的灼烧，在若干秒内持续造成百分比最大生命值的魔法伤害。
augments.description_ja: 自身の体力回復効果とシールドが、近くの敵1体に炎上のスタックを1つ付与する。これは無限にスタックし、数秒かけて最大体力の一定割合の魔法ダメージを与える。
augments.description_ko: 체력을 회복하거나 보호막을 씌울 때 주변 적에게 무한히 중첩되는 화상 효과를 적용해 몇 초에 걸쳐 최대 체력에 비례하는 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

augments.name: I'm a Baby Kitty Where is Mama
augments.displayName: I'm a Baby Kitty Where is Mama

names.en: I'm a Baby Kitty Where is Mama
names.zh_tw: 我是小貓咪媽咪在哪裡
names.ja: ボクは子ネコ。ママはどこ？

augments.name_zh_TW: 我是小貓咪媽咪在哪裡
augments.name_ja: ボクは子ネコ。ママはどこ？
augments.description_zh_TW: 站在友軍旁邊會將其標記為媽媽。 向媽媽移動時會增加跑速。接近媽媽時，增加跑速、治療量和護盾量。
augments.description_zh_CN: 站在一个友军的附近并将其标记为你的妈妈。 当朝着妈妈移动时，获得移动速度。当靠近你的妈妈时，获得移动速度、治疗和护盾强度。
augments.description_ja: 味方の隣に立つと、その味方が自分のママとしてマークされる。 ママに向かう際は、移動速度が増加する。ママの側にいると、移動速度、体力回復効果、シールド量が増加する。
augments.description_ko: 아군 옆에 서 있으면 해당 아군에게 자신의 엄마라는 표식을 남깁니다. 엄마를 향해 이동할 때 이동 속도를 얻습니다. 엄마 주위에 있으면 이동 속도, 체력 회복 및 보호막 효과를 얻습니다.

augments.name: It's Critical
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 50% critical strike chance.
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加%i:scaleCrit% @CritChance*100@%暴擊率。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得%i:scaleCrit%@CritChance*100@%暴击几率。
augments.description_ja: クリティカル率が%i:scaleCrit% @CritChance*100@%増加する。
augments.description_ko: %i:scaleCrit% 치명타 확률이 @CritChance*100@% 증가합니다.

augments.name: Jeweled Gauntlet

names.ja: ジュエル ガントレット

augments.name_ja: ジュエル ガントレット
augments.wikiDescription: Your abilities can now critically strike for (145% + bonus critical damage) damage. Additionally, gain 25% (+ 4.5% per 100 AP) critical strike chance. If both Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability are equipped, only rolls the critical strike chance of the augment that has the higher critical damage (or either if equal). The interaction between Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability may behave incorrectly with persistent area damage effects.(bug)
augments.description_zh_TW: 技能可以暴擊。 增加%i:scaleCrit% @CritGranted@%暴擊率。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的技能可以造成暴击。 获得%i:scaleCrit% @CritGranted@暴击几率。
augments.description_ja: スキルがクリティカル判定を持つ。 クリティカル率が%i:scaleCrit% @CritGranted@増加する。
augments.description_ko: 스킬에 치명타가 적용될 수 있습니다. %i:scaleCrit% 치명타 확률이 @CritGranted@% 증가합니다.

augments.name: Keystone Conjurer

names.ja: キーストーンの奇術師

augments.name_ja: キーストーンの奇術師
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得召喚：艾莉及奧術彗星關鍵符文。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得召唤：艾黎和奥术彗星基石符文。
augments.description_ja: キーストーンルーンの「エアリー召喚」と「秘儀の彗星」を獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 콩콩이 소환과 신비로운 유성 핵심 룬을 얻습니다.

augments.name: Laser Heal
augments.description_zh_TW: 施放持續2.5秒的雷射，為友軍回復生命，並對敵軍造成魔法傷害和緩速效果。
augments.description_zh_CN: 施放一个持续2.5秒的治疗激光，治疗友军，使敌人减速并对其造成魔法伤害。
augments.description_ja: 2.5秒間、レーザーを放って味方の体力を回復し、敵にスロウ効果と魔法ダメージを与える。
augments.description_ko: 2.5초 동안 광선을 발사해 아군에게는 체력을 회복시키고, 적에게는 마법 피해를 입히며 둔화시킵니다.

augments.name: Lightning Strikes

names.ja: ライトニングストライク

augments.name_ja: ライトニングストライク
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加@TotalASValue*100@%總攻速。 每秒普攻次數達@Breakpoint1@次時，造成額外魔法傷害{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@TotalASValue*100@%总攻击速度。 在@Breakpoint1@攻击次数/秒时，造成额外的魔法伤害 {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}。
augments.description_ja: 合計攻撃速度が@TotalASValue*100@%増加する。 毎秒攻撃回数が@Breakpoint1@回になると、追加で魔法ダメージ{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}を与える。
augments.description_ko: 총 공격 속도가 @TotalASValue*100@% 증가합니다. 초당 공격 횟수 @Breakpoint1@회에서 추가 마법 피해({{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }})를 입힙니다.

augments.name: One Trick Pony
augments.name_ja: ワントリック ポニー
augments.wikiDescription: Added to ARAM Mayhem in Patch 26.12. Riot lists this augment in the official patch notes; its full client tooltip is not exposed in the current 16.12 augment file yet.

augments.name: Orbital Laser
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得衛星雷射炮召喚師技能。 在短暫延遲後，發射衛星雷射炮，造成@DamagetoChampions*100@%最大生命的真實傷害，且在@GroundDuration@秒內造成@TotalDamageOverTimeTooltip@魔法傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得召唤师技能轨道镭射。 在一阵延迟后，召唤一道轨道镭射光束落下，造成@DamagetoChampions*100@%最大生命值的真实伤害外加在@GroundDuration@秒里持续造成共@TotalDamageOverTimeTooltip@魔法伤害。
augments.description_ja: 軌道レーザーのサモナースペルを獲得する。 発動から少し遅れて、軌道レーザーが降り注ぎ、@GroundDuration@秒かけて最大体力の@DamagetoChampions*100@%にあたる確定ダメージと@TotalDamageOverTimeTooltip@の魔法ダメージを与える。
augments.description_ko: 궤도형 레이저 소환사 주문을 얻습니다. 잠시 후 궤도형 레이저로 최대 체력의 @DamagetoChampions*100@%에 해당하는 고정 피해를 입히고, 추가로 @GroundDuration@초 동안 @TotalDamageOverTimeTooltip@의 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

augments.name: Pat On The Back
augments.wikiDescription: Allies encourage you when you walk past, granting you a Shield and Movement Speed.

augments.name: Perseverance
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 1000% base health regeneration, increased to 2000% while below 25% maximum health.
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加大量生命回復，生命低於一定值時增加更多。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得巨幅提升的生命回复，这个数额会在低生命值时进一步提升。
augments.description_ja: 体力自動回復が大幅に増加する。体力が低下すると、回復量がさらに増加する。
augments.description_ko: 체력 재생 효과가 크게 증가하고 체력이 낮으면 추가로 증가합니다.

augments.name: Poro Blaster
augments.description_zh_TW: 你持續收集普羅。對敵軍造成傷害時，朝目標發射所有普羅，每隻造成最大生命的真實傷害。若你有5隻普羅，牠們將造成一次擊退。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你周期性地召集魄罗。伤害一个敌人时会对其发射所有魄罗，每个魄罗造成目标最大生命值真实伤害。如果你有5个魄罗，那么它们会进行一次击退。
augments.description_ja: 時間経過でポロを集める。敵にダメージを与えると、すべてのポロを発射し、それぞれが最大体力に応じた確定ダメージを与える。ポロが5体いると、1回ノックバックする。
augments.description_ko: 시간에 따라 포로를 모읍니다. 적에게 피해를 입히면 모든 포로를 대상에게 발사해 각각 최대 체력 비례 고정 피해를 입힙니다. 포로가 5마리 있다면 대상을 잠시 뒤로 밀어냅니다.

augments.name: Pursuit of Power
augments.wikiDescription: QUEST: Hit enemy champions with your chosen ability the required number of times. REWARD: Permanently increase your chosen ability damage.

augments.name: Quantum Computing
augments.wikiDescription: Automatically cast an improved version of Camille's Tactical Sweep when an enemy champion is within 650 units of you, winding up over 0.75 seconds to slash in a 650 radius around you. The slash deals 200 – 350 (based on level) (+ 75% bonus AD) (+ 45% AP) physical damage to enemies within the area (30 second cooldown). Enemies hit by the outer edge of the circle take bonus physical damage equal to 10% (+ 2.5% per 100 bonus AD) (+ 1.6% per 100 AP) (+ 0.1% per 100 bonus health) of their maximum health and are slowed by 80% decaying over 2 seconds. Additionally, you are healed for 80% of the bonus post-mitigation damage against enemy champions hit by the outer edge.
augments.description_zh_TW: 定期自動施放一次大範圍斬擊。敵軍遭命中時會緩速，額外承受最大生命傷害，並讓你回復生命。
augments.description_zh_CN: 周期性地自动施放一次巨型斩击。被击中的敌人会被减速，受到额外最大生命值伤害，并且治疗你。
augments.description_ja: 一定時間ごとに自動発動で周囲を大きく斬りつける。また、命中した敵にスロウ効果および最大体力割合ダメージを与え、自身を回復させる。
augments.description_ko: 주기적으로 강력한 베기를 자동 사용합니다. 적중당한 적은 둔화되고 최대 체력에 비례한 피해를 추가로 받으며, 자신은 체력을 회복합니다.

augments.name: Quest: Support Main
augments.name_ja: クエスト：サポートメイン
augments.wikiDescription: QUEST: Heal allied champions for the required number of Health. REWARD: Any healing you provide now also Heals Over Time after the initial heal.

augments.name: Rabble Rousing
augments.wikiDescription: Casting an ability heals you for 5 – 60 (based on level) (+ 1% maximum health) . Toggled abilities will not trigger this augment as they do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects.

augments.name: Red Envelopes
augments.description_zh_TW: 紅包會隨機出現在你周圍。將其撿起即可獲得金錢與少量隨機能力值。
augments.description_zh_CN: 红包会随机出现在你周围。拾取它们会给你金币和少量的某个随机属性。
augments.description_ja: 紅いお年玉袋がランダムに周囲に出現する。拾うとゴールドと、ランダムなステータスが少量増加する。
augments.description_ko: 붉은 봉투가 주변에 무작위로 나타납니다. 붉은 봉투를 주우면 골드를 획득하고 소량의 무작위 능력치를 얻습니다.

augments.name: Rejuvenation
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to heal you for 30 – 100 (based on level) (+ 25% bonus AD) (+ 15% AP) (+ 5% bonus health). This is increased by up to 50% based on how long the ability's cooldown is, for a maximum heal of 45 – 150 (based on level) (+ 37.5% bonus AD) (+ 22.5% AP) (+ 7.5% bonus health).
augments.description_zh_TW: 使用{{SpellName}}可回復生命。
augments.description_zh_CN: 使用【{{SpellName}}】技能时回复生命值。
augments.description_ja: {{SpellName}}を使用すると体力が回復する。
augments.description_ko: {{SpellName}} 사용 시 체력을 회복합니다.

augments.name: Repulsor
augments.description_zh_TW: 生命低於@HealthThreshold*100@%時，擊退鄰近敵軍並使其緩速@SlowAmount*100@%。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在你跌下@HealthThreshold*100@%生命值时，对附近的敌人们造成击退和@SlowAmount*100@%减速。
augments.description_ja: 体力が@HealthThreshold*100@%未満に低下した際、周囲の敵をノックバックさせ@SlowAmount*100@%のスロウ効果を与える。
augments.description_ko: 체력이 @HealthThreshold*100@% 아래로 떨어지면 주변 적을 뒤로 밀어내고 @SlowAmount*100@% 둔화시킵니다.

augments.name: Restless Restoration
augments.description_zh_TW: 移動時持續回復生命。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你在移动时持续获得治疗。
augments.description_ja: 移動中、継続的に体力が回復する。
augments.description_ko: 이동 시 지속적으로 체력을 회복합니다.

augments.name: Self Destruct
augments.description_zh_TW: 每@BaseCooldown@秒，在自身放置一顆炸彈。炸彈在@BombDelay@秒後爆炸，造成真實傷害並擊飛敵軍。
augments.description_zh_CN: 每@BaseCooldown@秒，在你身上黏附一个炸弹。在@BombDelay@秒后，它会爆炸，对敌人们造成真实伤害和击飞效果。
augments.description_ja: @BaseCooldown@秒ごとに自身に爆弾を設置する。爆弾は@BombDelay@秒後に爆発し、確定ダメージを与え、敵をノックアップさせる。
augments.description_ko: @BaseCooldown@초마다 자신에게 폭탄이 부착됩니다. @BombDelay@초 후에 폭탄이 폭발해 적에게 고정 피해를 입히고 공중으로 띄워 올립니다.

augments.name: Slow And Steady
augments.description_zh_TW: 攻速變為@StaticRatio@。所有額外攻速轉換為物攻(每1%攻速轉換為@BaseAD@+@ADPerAS@物攻)。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的攻击速度变为@StaticRatio@。所有额外攻击速度会被转化为攻击力。(@BaseAD@外加@ADPerAS@攻击力每1%攻击速度)。
augments.description_ja: 自身の攻撃速度が@StaticRatio@になる。すべての追加の攻撃速度が攻撃力に変換される。(攻撃速度1%ごとに、@BaseAD@に加えて @ADPerAS@の攻撃力)。
augments.description_ko: 공격 속도가 @StaticRatio@의 수치로 고정됩니다. 모든 추가 공격 속도가 공격력으로 전환됩니다. (공격 속도 1%당 @ADPerAS@의 공격력+@BaseAD@)

augments.name: Slow Cooker
augments.description_zh_TW: 每秒對鄰近敵方英雄附加可無限累加的燃燒，傷害隨你的最大生命成長。
augments.description_zh_CN: 每一秒，对附近的敌方英雄们施加一层可无限叠加的灼烧，这个效果受益于你的最大生命值。
augments.description_ja: 毎秒、周囲の敵チャンピオンに無限にスタック可能な炎上を付与し、自身の最大体力に応じたダメージを与える。
augments.description_ko: 매초 최대 체력에 비례해 주변 적에게 무한히 중첩되는 화상 효과를 적용합니다.

augments.name: Snowball Upgrade
augments.wikiDescription: Your Mark is empowered to hail a snowstorm at the location where the target was hit for 2 seconds, granting sight of the area and dealing「 200 (+ 200% bonus AD) (+ 120% AP) magic damage 」「 25 (+ 25% bonus AD) (+ 15% AP) magic damage every 0.25 seconds 」to enemies within over the duration, as well as slowing them by 50% (+ 6% per 100 AP). Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 50 ability haste. If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.
augments.description_zh_TW: 讓你的雪球獲得@AbilityHaste@技能加速。命中敵軍時會降雪，造成範圍傷害並使鄰近敵軍緩速。 若你沒有雪球就會獲得一顆雪球。
augments.description_zh_CN: 雪球获得@AbilityHaste@技能急速。击中一个敌人时，会产生一次降雪，来对附近的敌人造成范围伤害和减速效果。 如果你没有雪球，获得一个雪球。
augments.description_ja: 雪玉のスキルヘイストが@AbilityHaste@増加する。敵に命中すると雪が降り、範囲ダメージを与え、周囲の敵にスロウ効果を付与する。 まだ持っていない場合は雪玉を1個獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 눈덩이의 스킬 가속이 @AbilityHaste@만큼 증가합니다. 적에게 눈덩이가 적중하면 눈이 내려 주변 적에게 광역 피해를 입히고 둔화시킵니다. 눈덩이를 보유하지 않은 경우 눈덩이를 얻습니다.

augments.name: Soul Siphon
augments.wikiDescription: Heal for 12% of the post-mitigation damage dealt by your critical strikes. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance. Any damage from Critical strikes will heal, including those from non-basic attack sources ( Talon's Noxian Diplomacy, Ashe's Volley, etc).
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得等同於暴擊造成傷害的@HealPercentage*100@%的治療。 增加%i:scaleCrit% @CritChance*100@%暴擊率。
augments.description_zh_CN: 暴击造成伤害的@HealPercentage*100@%会等额治疗你自身。 获得%i:scaleCrit% @CritChance*100@%暴击几率。
augments.description_ja: クリティカルによって与えたダメージの@HealPercentage*100@%にあたる体力を回復する。 %i:scaleCrit%クリティカル率が@CritChance*100@%増加する。
augments.description_ko: 치명타로 입힌 피해량의 @HealPercentage*100@%만큼 체력을 회복합니다. %i:scaleCrit% 치명타 확률이 @CritChance*100@% 증가합니다.

augments.name: Squishy Slappy Grab
augments.name_ja: スクイッシースラッピーグラブ
augments.wikiDescription: Occasionally send out squishy, slappy hands towards all nearby enemy champions, tethering them. Your next attack will pull in all tethered enemies.

augments.name: Tank It Or Leave It
augments.wikiDescription: Gain Critical Defend Chance equal to 100% critical strike chance, up to 50%. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance. Critical Defend Chance: Grants you a chance to reduce an instance of damage taken by 20% (5 second cooldown per enemy spell cast instance).
augments.description_zh_TW: 可根據自身暴擊率進行完美防禦(上限為@MaxChance*100@%機率)，觸發時減少承受的傷害。 增加%i:scaleCrit% @CritChance*100@%暴擊率。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你可以使用你的暴击几率(最大@MaxChance*100@%几率)来进行会心防御，使你有一定几率来使所受伤害降低。 获得%i:scaleCrit%@CritChance*100@%暴击几率。
augments.description_ja: クリティカル防御判定を持つようになる。これはクリティカル率の数値を参照し(最大確率は@MaxChance*100@%)、受けるダメージを軽減する。 %i:scaleCrit%クリティカル率が@CritChance*100@%増加する。
augments.description_ko: 공격당할 때 치명타 확률(최대 @MaxChance*100@%)에 따라 치명 방어가 발동해 받는 피해가 감소할 수 있습니다. %i:scaleCrit% 치명타 확률이 @CritChance*100@% 증가합니다.

augments.name: The Brutalizer
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加@AD@物攻、@AbilityHaste@技能加速、以及@Lethality@物理致命。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@AD@攻击力、@AbilityHaste@技能急速和@Lethality@穿甲。
augments.description_ja: 攻撃力が@AD@、スキルヘイストが@AbilityHaste@、脅威が@Lethality@増加する。
augments.description_ko: 공격력이 @AD@ , 스킬 가속이 @AbilityHaste@, 물리 관통력이 @Lethality@ 증가합니다.

augments.name: Tormentor
augments.description_zh_TW: 硬控場或禁錮敵方英雄時對其施加一項燃燒效果，造成持續傷害，可無限累加。
augments.description_zh_CN: 定身或缚地敌方英雄时提供一层灼烧，这个效果会持续造成伤害并可无限叠加。
augments.description_ja: 敵チャンピオンに移動不能効果か釘付け効果を付与すると、対象を炎上させて継続ダメージを与える。この効果は無限にスタックする。
augments.description_ko: 적 챔피언을 이동 불가 상태로 만들거나 이동 스킬을 사용할 수 없게 하면 무한히 중첩되는 화상 효과를 적용해 지속적으로 피해를 입힙니다.

augments.name: Trueshot Prodigy

names.ja: トゥルーショットプロディジー

augments.name_ja: トゥルーショットプロディジー
augments.description_zh_TW: 從遠處對敵方英雄造成傷害後，向對方發射精準彈幕。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在你从远处对一名敌人造成伤害时，对其发射一道精准弹幕。
augments.description_ja: 遠くからチャンピオンにダメージを与えると、対象に向けて「トゥルーショットバラージ」が発射される。
augments.description_ko: 멀리 떨어진 챔피언에게 피해를 입히면 정조준 일격을 발사합니다.

augments.name: Twice Thrice
augments.description_zh_TW: 每@ProcCadence@次普攻會觸發第二次{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}。
augments.description_zh_CN: 每@ProcCadence@次攻击，你的{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}效果会触发第二次。
augments.description_ja: 通常攻撃@ProcCadence@回ごとに、{{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}が2回発動する。
augments.description_ko: @ProcCadence@번째 기본 공격을 가할 때마다 {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} 효과가 한 번 더 발동합니다.

augments.name: Upgrade Cutlass

names.ja: カトラス アップグレード

augments.name_ja: カトラス アップグレード
augments.description_zh_TW: 將鬼使彎刀和生命之索的冷卻時間縮短至@UpgradeCD@秒。發動時，獲得@DamageAmp*100@%傷害增幅。 獲得250金錢。
augments.description_zh_CN: 【幽魂弯刀】和【救生索】的冷却时间降低至@UpgradeCD@秒。主动效果激活时，获得@DamageAmp*100@%伤害增幅。 获得250金币。
augments.description_ja: 「スペクトラル カトラス」と「ライフライン」のクールダウンが@UpgradeCD@秒に短縮される。発動中、ダメージ増加量が@DamageAmp*100@%増加する。 250ゴールドを獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 망령 해적검 및 생명선의 재사용 대기시간이 @UpgradeCD@초로 감소합니다. 사용 시 피해량이 @DamageAmp*100@% 증폭됩니다. 250골드를 획득합니다.

augments.name: Upgrade Hubris

names.ja: ヒュブリス アップグレード

augments.name_ja: ヒュブリス アップグレード
augments.description_zh_TW: 參與擊殺時，傲慢可讓你回復生命，並提升跑速，恢復量與提升量都會隨著顯赫層數增加。 獲得%i:goldCoins% 250金錢。
augments.description_zh_CN: 参与击杀时，【狂妄】会为你提供治疗和移动速度，随你的盛名层数增长。 获得+%i:goldCoins%250金币。
augments.description_ja: キルまたはアシストを獲得すると、「ヒュブリス」が自身を回復し、エミネンスのスタック数に応じて移動速度が増加する。 +%i:goldCoins%250ゴールドを獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 처치 관여 시, 오만이 체력을 회복시키고 이동 속도를 부여합니다. 두 효과 모두 명성 중첩에 비례하여 증가합니다. +%i:goldCoins% 250골드를 획득합니다.

augments.name: Upgrade Mikael's Blessing

names.ja: ミカエルの祝福 アップグレード

augments.name_ja: ミカエルの祝福 アップグレード

augments.name: Upgrade Thornmail

names.ja: ソーンメイル アップグレード

augments.name_ja: ソーンメイル アップグレード
augments.description_zh_TW: 脫離戰鬥@ThornshieldCooldown@秒後，你的「荊棘之甲」或「刺藤胸甲」生成外殼，反彈更多普攻傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 在脱离战斗@ThornshieldCooldown@秒后，你的【荆棘之甲】或【棘刺背心】会生成一个甲壳来回敬更多伤害给攻击者。
augments.description_ja: 戦闘状態を離れて@ThornshieldCooldown@秒経過すると、「ソーンメイル」または「ブランブル ベスト」が殻を生成し、通常攻撃からの反射ダメージが増加する。
augments.description_ko: 전투에서 벗어나고 @ThornshieldCooldown@초 후 가시 갑옷 또는 덤불 조끼가 기본 공격 피해량을 추가로 반사하는 껍질을 생성합니다.

augments.name: Vampirism
augments.wikiDescription: You can no longer be healed by allies and your health regeneration is set to 0. Gain 25% omnivamp. Diadem of Songs' Consonance and Moonstone Renewer's Starlit Grace will specifically not target champions with this augment.
augments.description_zh_TW: 你無法接受友軍治療，也無法獲得生命回復。獲得@OmniVamp*100@%全能吸血。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你不再能够被友军治疗或获得生命回复。获得@OmniVamp*100@%全能吸血。
augments.description_ja: 味方からの体力回復を受けられず、体力自動回復も獲得できない。@OmniVamp*100@%のオムニヴァンプを獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 아군이 자신의 체력을 회복시키거나 자신이 체력 재생을 얻을 수 없습니다. @OmniVamp*100@%의 모든 피해 흡혈 효과를 얻습니다.

augments.name: Void Dash
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a dash, empowering the ability to spawn a void zone (250 radius) at the dash's destination after a 0.3-second delay. Enemy champions within the zone are dealt 80 – 400 (based on level) (+ 100% ability haste) magic damage and are slowed by 35% for 1 second.
augments.description_zh_TW: 使用{{Spellname}}衝刺時會生成一個虛空區域，緩速敵方英雄並造成魔法傷害。
augments.description_zh_CN: 用【{{SpellName}}】技能冲刺时会产生一片【虚空地带】来对敌方英雄们造成减速和魔法伤害。
augments.description_ja: {{Spellname}}でダッシュすると「ヴォイドゾーン」を発生させる。このゾーンは敵チャンピオンにスロウ効果と魔法ダメージを与える。
augments.description_ko: {{Spellname}} 스킬로 돌진 시 적 챔피언을 둔화시키고 마법 피해를 입히는 공허 지대를 생성합니다.

augments.name: Void Rift
augments.description_zh_TW: 使用技能對敵軍造成傷害時，產生一道虛空裂痕。如附近有另一道虛空裂痕，它們會被吞沒並在中間產生一道裂縫，對範圍內的敵軍造成魔法傷害和緩速效果。
augments.description_zh_CN: 用技能对敌人造成伤害时，会制造一道虚空裂痕。如果附近有另一道虚空裂痕，则它们都会被消耗，以在它们之间生成一道裂隙，对其中的敌人们造成魔法伤害和减速。
augments.description_ja: スキルによって敵にダメージを与えると、ヴォイドの傷を生成する。近くに別のヴォイドの傷が存在すると、両方の傷が消費され、間に裂け目が発生する。裂け目内の敵に魔法ダメージを与え、スロウ効果を与える。
augments.description_ko: 적에게 스킬로 피해를 입히면 공허 상흔이 생성됩니다. 주변에 다른 공허 상흔이 있다면 두 상흔이 모두 사라지고 그 사이에 균열이 생성됩니다. 균열 내부에 있는 적은 마법 피해를 입고 둔화됩니다.

augments.name: Vulnerability
augments.wikiDescription: Damage dealt by items and damage over time effects can now critically strike for (145% + bonus critical damage) damage (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance. If both Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability are equipped, only rolls the critical strike chance of the augment that has the higher critical damage (or either if equal). The interaction between Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability may behave incorrectly with persistent area damage effects.(bug)
augments.description_zh_TW: 道具與持續傷害效果可以暴擊。 增加%i:scaleCrit% @CritChance*100@%暴擊率。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的装备效果和持续伤害效果可以暴击。 获得%i:scaleCrit% @CritChance*100@%暴击几率。
augments.description_ja: アイテムおよび継続ダメージ効果がクリティカル判定を持つ。 %i:scaleCrit%クリティカル率が@CritChance*100@%増加する。
augments.description_ko: 아이템 및 지속 피해 효과에 치명타가 적용될 수 있습니다. %i:scaleCrit% 치명타 확률이 @CritChance*100@% 증가합니다.

augments.name: Weighted Popoffs
augments.description_zh_TW: 技能命中敵軍時，賦予你爆發堆層，縮短非大絕技能冷卻時間。
augments.description_zh_CN: 用技能击中敌人时，会为你提供【爆气】层数，从而缩短你的非终极技能冷却时间。
augments.description_ja: スキルで敵にダメージを与えると、ポップオフのスタックを獲得し、アルティメット以外のスキルのクールダウンが短縮される。
augments.description_ko: 스킬로 적을 타격하면 폭주 중첩을 얻어 기본 스킬 재사용 대기시간이 감소합니다.

augments.name: Wind Beneath Blade
augments.description_zh_TW: 物理穿透和魔法穿透越高，跑速越快。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的护甲穿透和法术穿透越高，你就移动得越快。
augments.description_ja: 物理防御貫通と魔法防御貫通が高いほど移動速度が増加する。
augments.description_ko: 방어구 관통력 및 마법 관통력이 높을수록 이동 속도가 빨라집니다.

augments.name: Zealot
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 35% (+ 5% per 100 AP) bonus attack speed and 25% (+ 5% per 100 AP) critical strike chance.
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加@Calc_Crit_Chance@暴擊率和@Calc_AS@攻速。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@Calc_Crit_Chance@暴击几率和@Calc_AS@攻击速度（随法术强度变化）。
augments.description_ja: クリティカル率が@Calc_Crit_Chance@、攻撃速度が@Calc_AS@増加する。
augments.description_ko: 치명타 확률을 @Calc_Crit_Chance@, 공격 속도를 @Calc_AS@ 얻습니다.

augments.name: Upgrade Sword of Blossoming Dawn

names.ja: 花咲く夜明けの剣 アップグレード

augments.name_ja: 花咲く夜明けの剣 アップグレード
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades Sword of Blossoming Dawn, empowering Peppermint to have its healing increased by 250%. Additionally, you gain 100% bonus attack speed.
augments.description_zh_TW: 增加@AttackSpeed*100@%攻速。 你對敵方英雄進行普攻時，破曉綻放之劍的治療效果提升至@PercentInc*100@%。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得@AttackSpeed*100@%攻击速度。 你对英雄的攻击会使来自【花晓之剑】的治疗效果提升@PercentInc*100@%。
augments.description_ja: 攻撃速度が@AttackSpeed*100@%増加する。 敵チャンピオンを攻撃すると、「花咲く夜明けの剣」の回復効果が@PercentInc*100@%に増加する。
augments.description_ko: 공격 속도를 @AttackSpeed*100@% 획득합니다. 적 챔피언 공격 시 꽃피는 새벽의 검 체력 회복량이 @PercentInc*100@%로 증가합니다.

augments.name: Earthwake
augments.wikiDescription: Dashing or blinking causes you to leave behind a trail from the location you moved to your destination that detonates after 0.75 seconds in a 300 radius, dealing 90 – 250 (based on level) (+ 125% bonus AD) (+ 60% AP) physical damage per explosion to enemies hit, reduced to 70% against minions. Enemies can be affected only once every second from all cast instances, and the effect is not triggered if you move beyond 2000 units with the dash or blink.
augments.description_zh_TW: 施放衝刺、閃現或傳送技能後會留下軌跡，軌跡會在@ExplosionDelayTime@秒後引爆。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的冲刺、闪烁或传送类技能会留下一条在@ExplosionDelayTime@秒后爆炸的轨迹。
augments.description_ja: ダッシュ、ブリンク、またはテレポートを行うスキルを使用すると軌跡が残る。軌跡は@ExplosionDelayTime@秒後に爆発する。
augments.description_ko: 돌진, 점멸, 순간이동 스킬이 @ExplosionDelayTime@초 후에 폭발하는 흔적을 남깁니다.

augments.name: Flashy
augments.wikiDescription: Your Flash now has 3 charges with a 2-second cooldown between casts (120 seconds recharge time for all 3 charges). If Flash is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Flash.
augments.description_zh_TW: 你可以使用@MaxAmmo@次閃現，冷卻時間為@FlashCooldown@秒。
augments.description_zh_CN: 你的闪现有@MaxAmmo@层充能，并且冷却时间为@FlashCooldown@秒。
augments.description_ja: 「フラッシュ」が@MaxAmmo@回分のチャージを獲得し、クールダウンが@FlashCooldown@秒間になる。
augments.description_ko: 점멸 사용 가능 횟수가 @MaxAmmo@번, 재사용 대기시간이 @FlashCooldown@초가 됩니다.

augments.name: Transmute: Gold
augments.wikiDescription: Gain one random Gold-tier augment.
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得一件隨機%i:Augment%金色增幅裝置。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得1个随机%i:Augment%黄金阶强化符文。
augments.description_ja: ランダムな%i:Augment%ゴールドオーグメントを1個獲得する。
augments.description_ko: 무작위 %i:Augment% 골드 증강을 획득합니다.

augments.name: Sneakerhead
augments.wikiDescription: Assigns quests that require you to perform specific tasks while equipped with a particular Boots item, which is granted to you for free during its respective quest. Finish the following quests, which are assigned to you in a random order: Quest - Berserker's Greaves: Basic attack 25 times. Quest - Boots of Swiftness: Run 300 steps. Quest - Ionian Boots of Lucidity: Cast 20 abilities. Quest - Mercury's Treads: Become afflicted by crowd control 5 times. Quest - Plated Steelcaps: Reduce a total of 200 damage with Plating. Quest - Sorcerer's Shoes: Deal a total of 1500 damage with abilities. Reward: Upon completing all of the above quests, you receive Jarvan I's. You cannot purchase any Boots items while equipped with this augment. If you already have a Boots item, it is replaced by the Boots granted by this effect. Boots items gained from this effect cannot be sold.
augments.description_zh_TW: 立即：獲得1雙隨機升級版靴子。 條件：完成任務可換另一雙。 獎勵：嘉文一世的靴子
augments.description_zh_CN: 即刻：随机获得一双升级后的靴子。 需求：完成其任务，以更换为另一双。 奖励：嘉文一世之靴
augments.description_ja: 即時: ランダムなアップグレード後のブーツを獲得する。 条件: クエストを完了すると別のものと交換できる。 報酬: ジャーヴァンI世のブーツ
augments.description_ko: 즉시: 한 쌍의 무작위 업그레이드 장화를 얻습니다. 조건: 해당 장화의 퀘스트를 완료하여 다음 퀘스트를 받으세요. 보상: 자르반 1세의 장화

augments.name: ReEnergize
augments.description_zh_TW: 獲得一次充能普攻，造成@TargetCurrentHealthRatio*100@%目標現有生命的傷害。若該目標並非上次的目標，則使用次數會完全返還。
augments.description_zh_CN: 获得一次盈能攻击，它造成@TargetCurrentHealthRatio*100@%目标当前生命值的伤害。你的盈能攻击充能数会得到全额返还，如果目标与你前一次攻击的目标不是同一个。
augments.description_ja: エネルギー充填状態の通常攻撃を1チャージ獲得し、対象の現在体力の@TargetCurrentHealthRatio*100@%にあたるダメージを与える。対象が前回とは異なる場合、チャージが全回復する。
augments.description_ko: 충전 상태 공격을 얻어 대상 현재 체력의 @TargetCurrentHealthRatio*100@%에 해당하는 피해를 입힙니다. 대상이 이전 대상과 다르면 충전을 모두 돌려받습니다.

augments.name: Ult Bot
augments.wikiDescription: Your ability haste now only applies to the cooldown of your ultimate ability. In return, you gain 100 ability haste and your ability haste is 50% more effective.

augments.name: Snap Back
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability with a recast. Using the recast causes you to blink back to your original casting position of the ability and explode to deal 100 – 300 (based on level) (+ 20% AD) (+ 20% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies.
augments.description_zh_TW: 重施技能{{SpellName}}會引爆並返回你原本的位置。
augments.description_zh_CN: 再次施放【{{SpellName}}】技能时会产生爆炸，并回到你的原本位置。
augments.description_ja: {{SpellName}}を再発動すると爆発し、元の位置に戻る。
augments.description_ko: {{SpellName}} 재사용 시 폭발하며 원래 위치로 돌아갑니다.
